jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers.

You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust.

  • Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Data from our application databases, product events and SaaS tools needs to reach Snowflake reliably. You build and run that ingestion and decide where to buy a managed connector and where to build.

  • Our pipelines need clear dependencies, retries, alerting and SLAs. You set up orchestration so a failed or partial load stops downstream work instead of silently producing wrong numbers.

  • New products need event pipelines. You design them together with engineers, keeping patient data out of analytics events by design.

  • Product and Finance need to work from the same definitions. You maintain the dbt models that connect product usage with customer, billing and revenue data.

  • Our CRM (HubSpot) and our internal systems need to talk to each other. You build the data flows between them, including two-way synchronisation where it is needed.

  • Data quality problems need to be caught before a dashboard or a board report does. You establish validation, monitoring and alerting.

  • Our data needs strong privacy and access controls. You enforce role-based access and masking in Snowflake, pseudonymisation, and deletion that propagates across raw and modelled data.

  • Data code needs the same engineering standards as our product code. You bring code review, testing, documentation and CI/CD to it.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to move, model and protect data reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes (EKS) and Postgres (RDS)

  • Warehouse and modelling: Snowflake (EU), dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster (being introduced)

  • BI: Looker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Infrastructure: CloudFormation

  • Business systems: HubSpot, Chargebee


  • Several years (typically 5 or more) building production data pipelines, as a data engineer or as a backend engineer on data-intensive systems.

  • Strong Python: you write tested, maintainable production code, not only scripts.

  • Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs and query optimisation.

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse: compute sizing and cost control, role-based access, masking, and performance tuning.

  • Experience with dbt, or a similar tool for tested and documented transformations.

  • Solid ingestion fundamentals: initial versus incremental loads, change data capture from Postgres, idempotency, schema evolution, late and out-of-order data, and backfills.

  • Production experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster.

  • Experience with AWS and with deploying your own work in containers.

  • A data quality mindset: you profile data, test assumptions and build checks.

  • Practical knowledge of GDPR: you can identify personal data and implement pseudonymisation, access control and deletion.

  • You use AI coding tools in your daily work and know where they help and where they need checking.

  • Ability to own decisions as the only data engineer and to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages are a plus.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Integrating CRM and SaaS systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including reverse ETL or two-way sync.

  • Designing product event tracking (e.g. Snowplow or Segment).

  • Kubernetes in production.

  • Reading and changing Go code.

  • Managing Snowflake as code.

  • German language skills.

Our values

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

Du kommer att arbeta i ett högt tempo och krävs därför att kunna behålla lugnet och göra välgrundade beslut även i stressiga situationer.För att vara aktuell för rollen som arbetsledare bör du ha följande kvalifikationer:    Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta inom snabbmatsbranschen eller liknande bransch.    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en ledarskapsroll eller liknande position.    Kunskap om livsmedelssäkerhet och hygienstandarder.    God kommunikationsförmåga och förmåga att motivera och coacha medarbetare.    Förmåga att arbeta flexibla tider, inklusive kvällar och helger.Vi är stolta över att kunna erbjuda en dynamisk och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där du har möjlighet att utveckla din karriär inom företaget. Vi erbjuder även konkurrenskraftiga löner och förmåner.Om du tror att du har vad som krävs för att vara vår nästa arbetsledare, skicka in din ansökan nu!Det är enkelt att ansöka, det tar bara några minuter. Ansökan består av några urvalsfrågor och tre korta videofrågor som du kan besvara när som helst. Vi prioriterar attityd och inställning över tidigare erfarenheter, så vi lägger stor vikt vid dina videosvar. Lycka till!

jobs.title: Project leader – Dynamics 365 F&O
jobs.description: About us At Techrytera AB, recruitment starts with you. We are a staffing and recruitment company with deep expertise and a clear focus on IT and Engineering. With our industry knowledge and close dialogue with both candidates and clients, we create precise matches where the right skills meet the right needs.We believe that a truly great match is not just about a job description – it’s about your experience, your potential, and what you genuinely want to develop in. By understanding your background, motivations, and ambitions, we can connect you with assignments and roles at our clients where you have the right conditions to grow and make an impact.Our goal is to build long-term and meaningful collaborations – for both you as a candidate and for our clients. Job Description We are looking for an experienced and delivery-focused Implementation Manager / IT Project Leader to lead Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain implementations across multiple business units in a complex international organisation.In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and driving IT delivery throughout the implementation lifecycle, from planning and configuration to data migration, integrations, hypercare and handover. You will lead a team of D365 functional and technical consultants and ensure that technical delivery remains aligned with business requirements and the overall project plan.You will act as the primary IT counterpart to business-side project and implementation managers and coordinate dependencies across solution design, development, integrations, external vendors and other relevant stakeholders. The role also includes managing market-specific configurations and deviations from standard solutions, as well as monitoring progress, risks and dependencies to ensure timely and successful delivery.Qualifications    You have proven experience leading end-to-end Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain (F&O) implementations.    You have strong project management and leadership experience in global and cross-functional environments.    You have a solid understanding of ERP implementation methodologies and lifecycle phases.    You have experience coordinating stakeholders across business, IT and external vendors.    You have knowledge of integrations, data migration strategies and ERP architecture.    You have experience working in complex environments with multiple dependencies.    You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills ApplicationWhen you apply through Techrytera AB, you’re not just applying for a job – you’re starting a dialogue about your career path. We want to get to know you, your experience, and your ambitions so that we can match you with the right opportunities at our clients.Does this sound interesting? Submit your application or get in touch with us to learn more. We look forward to discovering the next step in your career together with you.

jobs.title: Chef d'équipe manutentionnaire bâtiment H/F
jobs.description: JPL Aménagement est une entreprise spécialisée dans les travaux d'aménagement et de second œuvre.Nos activités comprennent notamment :-Travaux de second œuvre-Démolition et curage-Dépose et évacuation de matériaux-Manutention et approvisionnement de chantier-Pose de cloisons-Pose de faux plafonds-Travaux d'aménagement intérieur-Travaux et interventions en extérieurDans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons un Chef d'équipe manutentionnaire / bâtiment capable d'intervenir directement sur les chantiers et d'encadrer une équipe.Le Chef d'équipe est responsable de la bonne organisation et de la réalisation des travaux qui lui sont confiés.Il doit être capable de travailler avec son équipe, répartir les tâches, donner les consignes, contrôler le travail réalisé et rendre compte à la direction ou au responsable de chantier.Nous recherchons avant tout une personne de terrain, autonome, sérieuse et capable de prendre des responsabilités.MISSIONS PRINCIPALESEncadrement de l'équipe-Encadrer une équipe de plusieurs ouvriers/manutentionnaires.-Répartir les tâches et organiser le travail quotidien.-Donner les consignes de travail et de sécurité.-Contrôler la bonne exécution des tâches.-Suivre l'avancement du chantier.-Faire remonter les difficultés, besoins en matériel ou problèmes rencontrés.-Veiller à la bonne tenue et à la cohésion de l'équipe.-Être le relais entre les ouvriers et la direction / le responsable de chantier.Participation aux travauxLe Chef d'équipe doit être opérationnel et participer lui-même aux travaux.Il pourra notamment être amené à réaliser :-Travaux de manutention et de port de charges.-Chargement et déchargement de matériaux.-Approvisionnement des postes de travail.-Démolition intérieure.-Travaux de curage et de dépose.-Tri et évacuation des gravats et déchets.-Dépose de cloisons, plafonds et différents éléments existants.-Préparation des supports.-Pose de cloisons et doublages.-Pose de faux plafonds.-Travaux divers de second œuvre.-Nettoyage et remise en état des zones de chantier.-Travaux de préparation et interventions en extérieur.Votre profil :-Vous êtes titulaire du permis B obligatoirement.-Vous maîtrisez la langue française à l'oral et à l'écrit.-Expérience dans le bâtiment, le second œuvre, la démolition, le curage ou la manutention.-Capacité à encadrer et organiser une équipe.-Bonne compréhension et respect des consignes de sécurité.-Ponctualité, sérieux et fiabilité.Savoirs etre : - Sérieux et ponctuel- Dynamique et volontaire- Autonome et organisé-Capable de travailler en équipe- Respectueux des règles de sécurité- Capable de prendre des initiativesUne expérience en tant que chef d'équipe est un plus.Nous pouvons également étudier le profil d'un ouvrier expérimenté souhaitant évoluer vers un poste de chef d'équipe, à condition qu'il dispose des qualités humaines et du sens des responsabilités nécessaires.Qualités humaines attendues : - Leadership- Autorité naturelle- Esprit d'équipe - Autonomie, réactivité et fiabilitéDans le cadre de ses fonctions, le Chef d'équipe pourra être amené à conduire et utiliser un véhicule mis à disposition par JPL Aménagement pour les besoins professionnels : déplacements sur les chantiers, transport de matériel et d'outillage, approvisionnement, évacuation de matériaux et autres déplacements liés à l'activité de l'entreprise.Le salarié devra :- Utiliser le véhicule uniquement dans le cadre des besoins professionnels de l'entreprise, sauf autorisation expresse de la direction.- Être titulaire d'un permis B valide et en mesure de le présenter sur demande.- Respecter strictement le Code de la route et les règles de sécurité routière.- Adopter une conduite responsable et adaptée aux conditions de circulation et de chantier.- Veiller à la propreté du véhicule

jobs.title: Technicien de maintenance générale (H/F)
jobs.description: Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recrutons un(e) Technicien(ne) de maintenance générale H/F - Électricité & Bâtiments. Le poste est basé sur notre siège social à Tresses (33).Rattaché au service Achats Moyens Généraux, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des installations électriques, ainsi que la maintenance générale du site et des bâtiments.Maintenance générale du site et des bâtiments * Assurer l'entretien courant et le maintien en bon état des bâtiments et installations du site ; * Réaliser les travaux de maintenance de premier niveau : plomberie, serrurerie, menuiserie, petite maçonnerie, peinture et réparations diverses ; * Assurer l'entretien et le dépannage des portes, portails, clôtures, éclairages et équipements des locaux ; * Identifier les anomalies ou dégradations constatées sur les bâtiments et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires ; * Effectuer des contrôles réguliers des installations et équipements du site et signaler toute situation présentant un risque pour les personnes ou les biens ; * Participer aux travaux d'aménagement, d'amélioration et de remise en état des locaux ; * Réaliser ou coordonner les petites interventions nécessaires au maintien du site en bon état de fonctionnement ; * Suivre les interventions des prestataires extérieurs lorsque les travaux nécessitent l'intervention d'une entreprise spécialisée ; * Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité lors de chaque intervention.Missions Maintenance électrique * Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements d'origine électrique ou électromécanique ; * Localiser l'origine des anomalies et déterminer les actions correctives nécessaires ; * Réaliser les opérations de dépannage et de réparation par remplacement ou remise en état des éléments défectueux ; * Intervenir sur les armoires électriques, éclairages, moteurs et différents équipements électriques et électromécaniques ; * Lire et exploiter les plans et schémas électriques nécessaires aux interventions ; * Contrôler et vérifier les installations à l'aide des appareils de mesure adaptés ; * Réaliser les essais et tests de fonctionnement après intervention ; * Effectuer les opérations de maintenance préventive afin d'anticiper les pannes et de garantir la disponibilité des équipements ; * Participer aux travaux d'installation, de modification et de câblage électrique sur les équipements neufs ou existants.Titulaire d'une formation Bac Pro à Bac+2 en électricité, électrotechnique ou maintenance, vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins 3 ans sur un poste de maintenance, idéalement acquise dans un environnement transport, logistique ou technique.Nous recherchons avant tout une personne expérimentée et de terrain, capable d'être rapidement autonome dans ses interventions.Vous maîtrisez le diagnostic et le dépannage électrique, la lecture de schémas électriques ainsi que les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective.Rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et autonome, vous avez le sens du service et des priorités et êtes particulièrement attentif(ve) au respect des règles de sécurité.Permis B indispensableCe que nous proposons : * Contrat de travail à durée indéterminée (CDI) * Pack rémunération attractif (42K€ à 44K€) - Rémunération conforme au seuil Living Wage interne * Mutuelle * Titres restaurant * Avantages CSE

jobs.title: Ingénieur génie électrique (H/F)
jobs.description: Rattaché à la BU Naval de notre division Développement Produits & Systèmes, vous intervenez directement sur le site de notre client basé dans le Cotentin et acteur majeur dans le secteur naval. Au cœur de différents programmes naval d'envergure, nous recherchons un ingénieur génie électrique qui a à cœur de réaliser des études techniques en électricité. Vos missions : * Réaliser les études électriques à partir des cahiers des charges et des spécifications techniques, * Concevoir et mettre à jour les schémas électriques, * Élaborer les plans d'implantation, de câblage et de raccordement des équipements, * Participer au dimensionnement des installations électriques, * Garantir la conformité des études aux exigences techniques et aux normes en vigueur, * Assurer les échanges techniques avec les différents intervenants du projet * Accompagner les équipes systèmes dans leurs échanges techniques avec les fournisseurs, en garantissant la conformité des exigences électriques (analyse et validation des documents techniques), * Participer aux revues de conception des différents lots en tant qu'expert électricité et remonter les points critiques identifiés, * Contribuer à la coordination technique des interfaces électriques.Poste à pourvoir rapidement. D'une formation Ingénieur ou BAC+5 en génie électrique, électrotechnique ou équivalent vous justifiez d'une expérience minimale de 2 ans idéalement dans le domaine des infrastructures industrielles et/ou navales.Vous disposez de compétences dans les domaines techniques suivants : * Distribution électrique et plan topographique, * Une maîtrise de See ELECTRICAL, * Une bonne maîtrise de la conception de schémas électriques, * Une solide connaissance des installations électriques industrielles, * Une bonne capacité d'analyse et de lecture de documents techniques, * Capacité à analyser et valider des documents techniques (schémas, notes de calcul, dossiers fournisseurs), * Gestion de projet.Doté d'un excellent relationnel, vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, tout en étant à l'aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés et défendre des enjeux techniques.Les raisons de nous rejoindre :  * Un management de proximité issu de la technique et un suivi personnalisé pour développer vos compétences et construire votre parcours parmi nous, * Un package d'avantages à découvrir (RTT, paniers repas, prise en charge à 75% de votre abonnement en transport en commun, forfait mobilité durable, participation employeur à la mutuelle d'entreprise, primes sur objectifs, etc.) * Une prime estivale qui fait du bien au moral ! * Un parcours d'intégration adapté et structuré où vous serez accompagné par un référent dédié, * Une Politique dynamique de Qualité de Vie au Travail, * Partager nos valeurs et participer au développement de notre engagement écologique et éthique.

jobs.title: Usineur / Usineuse commande numérique (H/F)
jobs.description: Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client qui est une entreprise locale et reconnue dans le secteur industriel, recherche un(e) Usineur(se) commande numérique (H/F).Missions principales :- Analyser les plans de fabrication et les documents techniques.- Paramétrer et piloter les machines à commande numérique à l'aide des logiciels adaptés.- Choisir les outils de coupe et les équipements nécessaires à chaque opération.- Assurer le suivi des cycles d'usinage et corriger les réglages lorsque cela est nécessaire.- Contrôler la conformité des pièces réalisées à l'aide d'instruments de mesure.- Participer à la maintenance de premier niveau des équipements et remonter toute anomalie constatée.Conditions de travail :- Les horaires sont organisés selon le planning de production, avec un fonctionnement en équipes alternées 2x8Profil recherché :- D'une formation en usinage, productique ou mécanique industrielle (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS, BP ou CQP).- D'une première expérience réussie sur un poste similaire en environnement industriel.- D'un sens aigu de l'organisation et d'une grande rigueur dans l'exécution des tâches confiées.- D'une forte sensibilité à la qualité et au respect des tolérances de fabrication.Aquila RH Lot-Et-Garonne est labellisé parcours TH. jobs.title: Mécanicien poids lourd (H/F)
jobs.description: Cette offre d'emploi est confiée à France Travail par LINDUSTRIE-RECRUTE.FRNous recherchons pour notre client, importante société spécialisée dans le secteur d'activité des transports routiers de marchandises, un/une :Mécanicien Poids Lourd (H/F) en CDI:Le poste est basé sur le site de DIJON (21000).Vous serez chargé des missions suivantes :-        Entretien courant et périodique des véhicules en atelier ;-        Mécanique courante, telle que : vidange, freins, pose et dépose de pièces, pose d'accessoires sur véhicules pré-équipés ;-        Diagnostic, dépose/repose, contrôle et réglage des ensembles mécaniques constituant les véhicules ;-        Effectuer les révisions nécessaires ;-        Préparation des véhicules pour le contrôle technique ;-        Utilisation documents techniques, entretien du poste de travail et d'outillage sous la Responsabilité du Chef de Parc et du Chef d'atelier.Vous êtes garant de la qualité de vos prestations lors de l'exécution des travaux et de la bonne utilisation du matériel confié (outillage.).Vous possédez des compétences techniques en mécanique poids lourd et autres en lien avec le métier.Votre sens de l'organisation et votre rigueur vous permettra de réussir à ce poste.Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez une bonne capacité d'adaptation, de la réactivité face à l'imprévu et le sens de l'initiative.Vous avez un bon relationnel et vous vous adaptez facilement.Le permis B est demandé. Les permis C et EC seraient un plus.Savoir utiliser une valise diagnostique TEXA serait un plus.

jobs.title: Auxiliaire de vie H/F
jobs.description: Vos missions :ET SI VOTRE MÉTIER AVAIT VRAIMENT DU SENS ?REJOIGNEZ NOTRE ÉQUIPE EN TANT QU'AUXILIAIRE DE VIE !Vous avez envie d'exercer un métier humain, utile et enrichissant ?Vous souhaitez rejoindre une agence où le respect, la bienveillance et la considération sont au cœur de nos priorités ?Chez nous, nous sommes convaincus que les qualités humaines comptent autant que les diplômes. jobs.title: Agent / Agente de fabrication en montage-assemblage mécanique (H/F)
jobs.description: Rattaché(e) au Responsable d'Unité de Production, votre mission principale consiste à assurer le nettoyage et/ou le sablage des pièces semi-finies et finies selon les gammes de fabrication, tout en respectant les exigences de qualité, de coût, de délai et de sécurité.Vous appliquez les consignes, programmes et cycles de nettoyage selon les instructions de poste et les gammes.   Vous réalisez les opérations de lavage ou de sablage manuel et surveillez les cycles de nettoyage.   Vous préparez, organisez et maintenez votre poste de travail en état.Vous assurez la maintenance de 1er niveau et faites remonter toute anomalie à votre responsable en participant aux démarches d'amélioration continue.

jobs.title: Canalisateur (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Adecco recrute pour le compte de l'un de ses clients un-e canalisateur (H/F) en intérim, pour intervenir sur des chantiers de réseaux enterrés .Vous intervenez sur la pose et la rénovation de canalisations, et contribuez au bon fonctionnement des réseaux d'eau et de fluides.Vous participez aux étapes du chantier, depuis la préparation jusqu'à la remise en état des lieux.Vous préparez le chantier en consultant les plans d'exécution, en repérant les réseaux existants, en réalisant le piquetage et le marquage au sol, et en mettant en place la signalisation ainsi que les mesures de sécurité. Vous assurez l'ouverture et le terrassement des tranchées, en découpant les revêtements de chaussée ou de trottoir, en creusant les fouilles de façon mécanique ou manuelle, puis en posant les blindages et protections nécessaires pour sécuriser les parois.Vous préparez le fond de fouille en réglant le lit de pose afin de garantir la pente et la stabilité des tuyaux. Vous participez à la manutention et à la pose de tuyaux de différents matériaux, réalisez l'emboîtement, la soudure ou le collage des pièces de raccordement et des regards, et contrôlez l'alignement et la pente. Vous effectuez des contrôles visuels ainsi que des essais d'étanchéité ou de pression, puis assurez le remblaiement, le compactage du sol et la remise en état de la voirie, des bordures, des trottoirs et des espaces verts.Ce poste en intérim est à pourvoir dès que possible, Ce poste convient à une personne souhaitant s'investir dans des chantiers de réseaux enterrés, appréciant le travail en extérieur et en équipe. Une première expérience dans les travaux publics ou la pose de canalisations souhaité..Compétences comportementales - Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans le respect des plans, des consignes et des délais. - Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et communiquez de façon claire et respectueuse sur le chantier. - Vous êtes réactif-ve face aux imprévus et savez vous adapter aux contraintes techniques et organisationnelles.Compétences techniques - Vous maîtrisez les bases de la préparation de chantier, du repérage des réseaux et de la mise en place de la signalisation. - Vous savez participer au terrassement, à la pose de blindages et à la préparation du lit de pose pour les canalisations. - Vous êtes à l'aise avec la pose, le raccordement des tuyaux et la réalisation des contrôles, essais et remises en état.Le processus de recrutement prévoit un entretien téléphonique avec Adecco, suivi d'un entretien physique avec notre client afin de valider vos compétences et votre motivation. Postulez sans attendre.

jobs.title: DIRECTEUR TECHNIQUE FERROVIAIRE - DIRECTEUR DE GRANDS PROJETS (H/F)
jobs.description: Description de l'entrepriseRejoindre Ingérop, c'est contribuer à façonner le monde de demain.Groupe d'ingénierie et de conseil indépendant, nous menons des projets ambitieux dans les domaines du bâtiment, de l'énergie, de l'industrie, de l'eau, des infrastructures, des transports et de la ville.Avec plus de 40 sites en France, 98 implantations dans le monde et plus de 3 500 collaborateurs, nous offrons de nombreuses opportunités, en conception comme en réalisation, en local comme à l'international.Chez Ingérop, vous évoluerez dans un environnement innovant, humain et solidaire, où l'expertise, l'esprit d'équipe et la convivialité sont au cœur de notre culture. fois le référent technique ferroviaire de l'agence et le directeur de projet de nos grandes opérations ferroviaires.Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Département Ferroviaire, vous travaillez en lien étroit avec la Direction Déléguée Ferroviaire & Systèmes de Transport France ainsi qu'avec les équipes Études et Travaux du département Infrastructures.Vos missions s'articulent autour de deux axes :1/ Direction technique ferroviaireAccompagnement technique des ressources en charge de la production technique de nos études (projeteurs, chargés d'études)Vérification des études ferroviaires (contrôle etc.)Participation aux REX projets internes et en présence du clientLe suivi des évolutions de textes réglementairesAppels d'offres : contribution technique, relecture et participation aux auditions jobs.title: IT-informationssäkerhetsspecialist
jobs.description: Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.Arbetsbeskrivning Du leder och genomför riskanalyser och granskningar inom cybersäkerhet. I rollen ingår även att stötta myndighetens medarbetare i arbetet med cybersäkerhet och dataskydd. Det innebär till exempel att du håller i utbildningar och att du arbetar med uppföljning inom området. Du arbetar både i vår agila nätverksorganisation och i linjeorganisationen för säkerhet. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt. Vi arbetar med kontinuerlig analys och utveckling av våra tjänster, vilket erbjuder spännande säkerhetsuppdrag och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Du får även möjlighet att vara med och påverka utvecklingen av myndighetens it-säkerhetsarkitektur. I förlängningen bidrar det till att du är med och skapar våra framtida digitala hälsodatalösningar.Obligatoriska krav:    Du ska inneha utbildning med examen på universitets/högskole/yrkeshögskolenivå eller motsvarande, om utbildning saknas ska konsulten arbetat minst sex (6) år inom rollen.    Du ska ha minst fyra (4) års yrkeserfarenhet av arbete med informationssäkerhet inom organisationer med samhällsviktig verksamhet    Minst två (2) år av yrkeserfarenheten ska vara förvärvad någon gång under den senaste fem (5) -årsperioden.    Du ska kunna kommunicera tydligt, korrekt och professionellt i både tal och skrift på svenska.    Du ska minst uppnå kompetensnivå 3 enligt ramavtalet: Kunskap: Hög generalistkompetens, eller mycket hög utbildning och kompetens inom området. Erfarenhet: Har deltagit i stora uppdrag inom området och genomfört uppdrag med mycket hög kvalitet. Nivån uppnås normalt tidigast efter 9-12 år inom området för aktuell bransch/område. Ledning: Tar huvudansvar för ledning av större grupp. Självständighet: Mycket stor.Meriterande krav:    Dubör ha minst ett års erfarenhet av cybersäkerhetsarbete inom myndighet och/eller inom vård- och omsorgssektorn    Du bör ha certifieringar inom områden som CISA, CISM, CISSP eller liknande    Du bör ha erfarenhet av arbete inom säkerhetsramverk/cyberskyddsmetoder som NIST CSF, CIS18 eller COBIT    Du bör ha yrkeserfarenhet av Samordnad och säker statlig it-drift.Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
About remove

remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment and Postcode Loterij Fonds.

About the role

We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.

What you will own

Strategy

  • Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

  • Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

  • Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

  • Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

  • Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

  • Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

People and team

  • Line-manage our program managers: debottleneck daily operations, set priorities, manage workload, coach the team, manage development plans, etc.

  • Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

  • Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

  • Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

  • Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

  • Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

  • Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

  • Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

  • Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are

You must have

  • 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

  • Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

  • A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

  • Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

  • Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

  • Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

  • A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

  • Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

  • Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

  • Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

  • Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

  • A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

  • This role reports to the two co-founders.

  • Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

  • Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

  • Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

  • A flexible and remote-first workplace.

  • An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

  • A unique opportunity to experience and shape strategy for a future billion-dollar industry in its early days.

  • Exposure to a great network and community of CDR innovators and experts.

  • A learning budget to develop yourself.

  • Flexible holidays and biannual team off-sites.

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter (no more than one page) detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be the ideal candidate for the role. We will review applications on a rolling basis and aim to start interviews as soon as possible, latest by mid November 2026.

Our process: a 30-minute introductory call with Rawan Gebran (Senior Director @ remove) followed by a take home task that you will present, then an interview with both co-founders, Hans Westerhof & Marian Krueger and a conversation with the team. We aim to make a decision by January 2027 for a start in April 2027. In the final round, we will ask for the contact details of 3 references willing to speak about their experience with you, professionally.

If you’ve built and run the strategic and operating backbone for a small and agile team before and want to do it for the organization helping CDR startups globally get off the ground, we want to hear from you! We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Montør kjøkken og interiør
jobs.description:
Scandic Mood er en virksomhet som opererer innen møbler og interiør, og som også har egen produksjon og gjennomføringsevne. Vi tilbyr levering og montering av produkter som krever installasjon, inkludert kjøkkenfronter, benkeplater, garderober, baderomsmøbler, bord, sofaer og senger.

Hva vi ser etter

Scandic Mood ser etter personer som både har praktiske ferdigheter og en riktig arbeidsinnstilling til å bli en del av teamet vårt.

Vi ser etter kandidater som er ansvarsbevisste, jobber nøyaktig og tar stolthet i arbeidet sitt. Evnen til å jobbe selvstendig, ta initiativ når det trengs og være løsningsorientert er viktige egenskaper for denne rollen.

Gode kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å bygge gode relasjoner med kunder og kolleger er også viktig. Samtidig er det en fordel å være samarbeidsvillig og kunne jobbe godt i team.

Vi verdsetter personer som er lærevillige og motiverte for å utvikle seg videre. Selv om erfaring er en fordel, tror vi at riktige personlige egenskaper og utviklingspotensial er like viktig, og at man kan vokse inn i rollen over tid.

Tekniske ferdigheter og forventninger:

  • Grunnleggende montering av kjøkken, garderober og baderomsmøbler

  • Evne til å ta mål og jobbe nøyaktig med enkle tekniske oppgaver

  • Kunne lese og følge monteringsinstruksjoner

  • Bruk av håndverktøy og grunnleggende monteringsutstyr

  • Evne til å finne praktiske løsninger ved behov på stedet

  • Fokus på ryddig, sikkert og effektivt arbeid

Denne kombinasjonen av personlige egenskaper og praktiske ferdigheter er viktig for å lykkes i rollen hos oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Levering av solgte produkter til kunde

  • Montering av kjøkkenfronter og kjøkkenmoduler

  • Tilpasning og installasjon av benkeplater (inkludert utskjæring for vask og platetopp)

  • Montering av garderobesystemer

  • Installasjon av baderomsmøbler

  • Montering av bord, sofaer og senger

  • Justering, kontroll og ferdigstillelse etter montering

  • Ved behov: måltaking og tilpasning av produkter på stedet

  • Også noe litte oppussing arbeidere.eks dør montering osv....

Vi tilbyr

Scandic Mood tilbyr et arbeidsmiljø som er aktivt involvert i hele prosessen fra produksjon til montering av møbler og interiørløsninger. Dette gir ansatte muligheten til å få bred erfaring og utvikle seg innen flere fagområder.

Hos oss får man mulighet til å jobbe med montering av kjøkken, garderober og baderomsmøbler, samt levering og ferdigstillelse hos kunde. Dette bidrar til både teknisk og praktisk kompetanseutvikling.

Arbeidet preges av ansvar, nøyaktighet og en løsningsorientert tilnærming. Arbeidsmiljøet er uformelt, men profesjonelt, hvor samarbeid og gjensidig respekt står sentralt.

I tillegg jobber vi med å etablere oss som et anerkjent og sterkt alternativ i markedet for disse produktgruppene. I denne prosessen ønsker vi å tilby våre medarbeidere en god fremtid både økonomisk og sosialt.

Per i dag jobber vi hovedsakelig prosjektbasert, men vi planlegger å tilby faste fulltidsstillinger innen kort tid.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Scandic Mood er en virksomhet som opererer innen møbler og interiør, og som også har egen produksjon og gjennomføringsevne. Selskapet tilbyr estetiske og funksjonelle løsninger for ulike boområder.

Vi tilbyr levering og montering av produkter som krever installasjon, inkludert kjøkkenfronter, benkeplater, garderober, baderomsmøbler, bord, sofaer og senger.

jobs.title: Clinical AI Research Lead
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

jobs.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer (ranging from mid to principal) to help build the models that underpin these control systems and help us level up our machine learning infrastructure.

Whether in research or deployment focussed teams, we operate as one cohesive unit, sharing tech stack, knowledge, and objectives. Our focus spans from fundamental ML research to commercial-grade software development, offering diverse learning and impact opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

Reporting to a Machine Learning Team Lead, you will:

  • Build state-of-the art systems which combine edge control with active learning algorithms to continuously deliver impact and reduce CO2 emissions.

  • Work in the machine learning team as an individual contributor, building, testing and deploying our models, optimisers and controllers.

  • Contribute to technical innovation and problem-solving across the machine learning lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer projects, planning, designing and delivering the work packages required, as well as playing a significant role in the development of our product.

  • Help establish best practices to improve our internal processes.

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of robust, maintainable and scalable machine learning systems.

You will also contribute to our fear-free development process by building tooling that helps the team move faster and more sustainably. You will be supported by continuous builds, tests, a constructive review system, and a strong culture of improving engineering processes.

What a great fit looks like

  • You have 2 or more years of experience as a machine learning engineer.

  • You are familiar with ML techniques, and have both theoretical ML knowledge and experience implementing different types of solutions.

  • You are proficient in Python and have a good understanding of the ecosystem of tools and libraries that support ML development (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch).

  • You have experience working in end-to-end machine learning deployments.

  • You have experience working in a scientific environment across disciplines (particularly physics, chemistry, materials science, and engineering), either through previous roles or study.

  • Are passionate about making a positive impact on climate change mitigation and possess a strong interest in our mission.

You’ll excel if

  • You have experience in any of: control systems, time-series modelling, reinforcement learning, system identification, optimisation or bayesian statistics.

  • You are used to working in a fast-paced startup environment with an agile process.

  • You have a degree in machine learning, physics, chemistry, engineering, mathematics or computer science.

  • You have a track record of developing novel ML methods in relevant fields.

  • You are hungry for responsibility, enthusiastic about taking on the design and development of solutions to difficult problems, and eager to drive the progress of new products.

  • You have a solid understanding of modern cloud compute infrastructure as it relates to machine learning, and experience in working with AWS, GCP, Azure, or other vendors.

  • You have have designed and built systems end to end with software architectural best practice.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

jobs.description:

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our team. You will own the systems that connect our models to our product: the data pipelines that feed them, the context they work with, the multi-agent systems they run in, and the metrics that tell us whether they work. You'll set the standards and patterns our team builds on and work closely with our ML and backend engineers to take AI functionality from prototype to reliable, production-grade systems.

As an early-stage startup, we pride ourselves on our ability to roll up our sleeves and build from scratch. You’ll ship code frequently, iterate quickly based on feedback, and still meet the stringent security, performance, and uptime requirements our clients expect.

We all love to build, scale, and grow: our leadership team has a strong track record of building products, scaling teams, and driving growth, and our ambitious engineers join us from leading tech companies and unicorns.

What you'll do

  • Own the data pipelines behind our AI platform end to end, turning register data and web content into parsed, structured data with a full audit trail and strong data-quality checks

  • Build the context management layer that decides what our agents and LLMs see, balancing relevance, token budgets, memory, and cost

  • Build the harnesses our agents run in: the agent loop, tool calling, context assembly, guardrails and tracing

  • Design and build multi-agent and autonomous agent systems, including the agent-to-agent interfaces that let our agents hand work to each other reliably

  • 5+ years of experience as a software, data, or ML engineer in product-centric settings

  • Experience in production-level Python and building backend services and APIs

  • Experience integrating LLMs in production and handling their practical limits: context windows, cost, latency, and non-determinism

  • Experience building agent harnesses and multi-agent, autonomous agent, or agent-to-agent systems in production

  • Experience setting up evaluation and metrics for AI systems, and using them to make decisions

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices, containers, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud platform

Our Offer

jobs.title: Data Center Architect
jobs.description:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

  • Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

  • Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

  • Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

  • Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

  • Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring:

  • 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

  • Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

  • Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

  • Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

  • Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

  • Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

  • Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

jobs.title: Founding Operations & Systems Lead
jobs.description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

 

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

     

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

     

What we're looking for

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV.

     

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty
    If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

     

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

     

Salary

£90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

 

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day.

 

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

 

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave
