jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering - Complex integrated systems
jobs.description:
PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering – AI tools for early validation and development of complex integrated systems

Do you want to contribute to the development of knowledge, insight and solutions that are relevant to society and working life today and in the future?

Some of tomorrow's most innovative systems are shaped by weather, ocean currents and thousands of design choices. How do you know that the design will work before it is built? Help engineers find out with the use of AI. We are looking for a PhD research fellow in Systems Engineering.

About the position

Do you want to help engineers design data-intensive systems where huge amounts of data and a vast design space make early decisions hard? Join us as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Science and Industry Systems, campus Kongsberg. Start: May 2027 (at the latest August 2027).

You will be part of SFI CELECT – the Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems – whose vision is to do more with less, and faster. The centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, brings together Norway's leading industrial companies and 30 PhD candidates across USN, NTNU and the University of Agder. You will also join the Industrial Research School in Complex Systems (INRESCOS).

Campus Kongsberg sits at the heart of one of Norway's strongest technology clusters, with world-leading companies in maritime, defence, aerospace, energy and subsea technology. Research and industry work side by side – giving you a unique network and strong career opportunities in industry or academia.

The position is a three-year educational position with pure organised research training. A four-year appointment with 25% career-advancing may be considered.

You must apply for and be admitted to the doctoral programme in Technology (Systems Engineering) within three months of starting. The programme includes courses of about six months (30 ECTS), an independent thesis, research dissemination, a trial lecture and a public defence.

Your main supervisor will be Professor Kristin Falk. Your workplace will be shared between campus Kongsberg and one or several CELECT partner companies: depending on the project, you will spend between 3 and 30 months located at a company's premises. You are expected to be present at campus or at the company during ordinary working hours.

About the doctoral project

The aim of this PhD is to develop AI-supported design methods and tools that enable early validation of complex, data-intensive integrated systems.

Data-intensive systems have huge design spaces, and their behaviour emerges from many interacting factors. Design and operation become intertwined – and today's methods catch problems too late.

In this PhD you will develop AI-supported design assistance: methods and tools, backed by digital twins, that help engineers explore large design spaces and validate systems early. Questions you could explore:

• How are data-intensive systems designed and validated in industry today?

• How can AI and digital twins support early design decisions?

You will help shape the final research questions together with your supervisors and industry partners.

The PhD project is part of SFI CELECT, headed by Professor Kristin Falk. Industrial cases will be selected among CELECT partners such as Kongsberg Maritime, Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, Siemens Energy, H. Henriksen, Umoe Mandal and cDynamics. Using industry as your laboratory, you will work alongside engineers and systems architects on real development projects.

This position is one of several related CELECT PhD positions at USN: it focuses on early design and validation, and complements positions on life-cycle management of long-living systems (PhD1.4), early systems integration in systems-of-systems (PhD1.5) and competence development for industry (PhD5.1).

You will be part of the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE).

Duties

  • Complete the doctoral programme up to completion of the doctoral degree within the employment period
  • Conduct high-calibre research within the framework described above
  • Academic publications in high-quality journals and conferences
  • Actively work with companies in an industry-as-laboratory environment, combining qualitative and quantitative research
  • Report progress and deliver outputs to the CELECT centre
  • Participate in the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE)
  • Active involvement in SFI CELECT's doctoral team across NTNU, USN and UiA, including the research school INRESCOS, and participation in common workshops, learning events and courses
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign research and educational institutions
  • Be prepared for changes in your work tasks after appointment
Qualifications

All items are requirements, unless it is specified that they are preferred qualifications.  

  • Master's degree (120 ECTS credits) (or equivalent qualifications) within Systems Engineering, Systems Architecture, mechanical, electrical, marine or software engineering, cybernetics, mechatronics, computer science or a similar relevant engineering discipline
  • Documented knowledge of relevant methodologies, both quantitative and/or qualitative, at master's level
  • Weighted average grade of B or higher on the master's degree and thesis
  • The master’s thesis must have been submitted for assessment by the application deadline for the position and approved before starting in the position
  • Understanding of and interest in AI/ML and data-driven engineering is preferred
  • Knowledge of systems architecting, model-based systems engineering, simulation or digital twins is preferred
  • Industrial experience from development of complex or integrated systems (for example maritime, aerospace, manufacture) is preferred
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2, is preferred
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills
  • Meet the formal requirements for admission to USN's doctoral programmes and the Faculty of Technology, Natural Sciences and Maritime Sciences' doctoral programme in Technology, with the topic of Systems Engineering, no later than three months after starting in the position

 

Personal qualities

In order to be able to complete a doctoral degree, you need to be able to:

  • demonstrate motivation and potential for research in the field
  • work independently, but also participate in teamwork
  •  work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them
  •  present and discuss your research with other academics
  • get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity
  • show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject area
  • analyse data, assess different perspectives, and draw well-founded conclusions
  • work collaboratively in an industrial setting with the CELECT partners
  • be flexible and open to adjusting the project plan as necessary
  • have the academic skills and personal qualities to be able to complete the doctoral programme within the employment period

 

When assessing applications, particular importance will be attached to: 

  • Formal qualifications
  • The personal qualities mentioned above
  • Motivation letter
  • Qualifications and experience in systems architecting, systems modelling, digital twins or closely related fields

 

Requirements for proficiency in English 

This position requires good English language skills. International applicants must document this with a valid certificate from one of the following tests. Specific requirements regarding grades can be found on our webpage English requirement for programmes and subjects taught in English at USN.

  • TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT)
  • IELTS – International English Language Testing Service 
  • Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) from the University of Cambridge
  • PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic

The following applicants are exempt from the requirements listed above:

  • Applicants with one year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or USA
  • Applicants who have completed a master’s degree with English as the language of instruction in an EU or EEA country
  • Applicants who are exempt based on the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir)’s GSU list (Higher Education Entrance Qualification for foreign applicants)

Applicants from Norway can confirm their English language skills by submitting their upper secondary school diploma.

Requirements for proficiency in Norwegian

The position has no formal requirement for proficiency in Norwegian. Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2 (language levels as defined by HK-dir), is preferred.

Applicants who wish this to be taken into account must document their language skills in the application (see How to apply).

Requirements regarding a licence and/or security clearance

The applicant must meet the requirements for authorization for restricted. You can read more about security clearance on the websites of the National Security Authority and the Civil Clearance Authority. For the position, an export licence is also required, and the applicant must meet the requirements for this. You can read more about export licences on DEKSA's website.

Motivation letter

Applicants must submit a motivation letter with the application. This should be short and concise, maximum 500 words.

The final project description and work plan will be prepared in consultation with the supervisor(s) during the first three months of the employment period. It is a prerequisite that you complete the project during the employment period.

What we offer
  • Organised research training in a large undertaking with an important social mission
  • Careers advice and guidance throughout the entire doctoral programme. Together we will draw up a career plan that includes the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • An inclusive working environment with ambitious colleagues
  • The opportunity to take Norwegian language courses
  • Salary in accordance with the Norwegian State salary scale for PhD research fellows (position code 1017) NOK 550,800. In special cases, code 1378 may be used. Any further increases in pay grade will be based on length of service in the position
  • Deductions will be made from your salary in order to make statutory contributions to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund on your behalf
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, ensuring favourable pension, insurance and loan schemes
Diversity

We believe that diversity is a resource in our work and learning environment. Different experiences and backgrounds contribute to different perspectives and better solutions to challenges that need to be solved.

We are committed to respecting each other's differences and will facilitate employees with disabilities. We take into account your needs and your situation in different phases of life.

If you find this position interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, disability, cultural background or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in their CV or an immigrant background, we will call at least one applicant in each of these groups for an interview. If you recognize yourself in one of these categories, you can tick the box in our job search portal.

The university aims to recruit more women to PhD positions within the field. If multiple applicants are considered to have equivalent qualifications, a woman will be given priority over a man.

General information

The Appointment Committee for Fellowship Positions (TUS) is the appointing authority for this position. Your competence for the position will be assessed by an expert committee. The expert committee will assess your competence for the position based on the documentation you have registered in Jobbnorge. 

Based on the expert committee’s assessment, relevant applicants will be invited to an interview and to hold a trial lecture. References will also be obtained for relevant candidates. 

Employment at USN is carried out in accordance with the principles set out in the Norwegian Civil Service Act, and the legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services. If your application is considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter legislation, it will be rejected without further consideration.

The University's Guidelines for Recruitment Positions provide a more detailed description of the criteria for appointment as a PhD research fellow.

As an employee of USN, you must at all times adapt to changes in the field and all organisational changes that are adopted.

How to apply

If you think this position looks interesting and matches your qualifications, you can submit an application electronically by clicking on “Apply for the position” on this page. Here you will need to enter a short application text and information about your relevant education and work experience. In the application text, you must clearly describe your skills and motivation for the position. 

The application must include:

  • Certified diplomas for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees (120 ECTS). The diplomas must be in a Scandinavian language or English
    • Applicants with higher education completed outside Norway must provide documentation that the education has been recognised and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) You must submit your application for approval before the position’s application deadline. Attach a receipt or decision when applying. The approval must be forwarded once available and is a requirement for employment.
  • An explanation of the grading system for foreign education (diploma supplement if available)
  • Other relevant certificates and diplomas
  • A motivation letter containing a personal statement explaining your motivation for the position, maximum 500 words
  • Documentation of your Scandinavian/Norwegian language skills (if relevant, see Requirements for proficiency in Norwegian)
    • Language proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish can be documented in the following ways:
      • a high school diploma
      • a diploma from higher education completed in a Scandinavian language
      • a passed language test that documents Norwegian skills at the B2 level, for example the “Norskprøve for innvandrere” or a level 3 Norwegian course at a higher education institution
  • Documentation of your English language skills (see Requirements for proficiency in English above)
  • List of any scholarly publications
  • Contact information for up to three references

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska eller barnmorska dag/natt, BB- och Gynavdelningen
jobs.description: Hos oss i Region Dalarna får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du kan göra skillnad. Tillsammans arbetar vi för ett hållbart Dalarna med utvecklingskraft i länets alla delar.Om verksamhetenOm BB/Gyn BB/Gyn är en gemensam vårdenhet som bedrivs på två plan. Här arbetar barnmorskor, sjuksköterskor och undersköterskor tillsammans i team, i nära samarbete med läkare, kurator och andra professioner utifrån patienternas behov. Under vardagar vårdas BB- och gynekologiska patienter huvudsakligen på olika plan. BB har 14 vårdplatser och gynekologin har 8 vårdplatser. Under helgerna är vi sammanslagna på ett plan med totalt 18 vårdplatser. Vi vårdar kvinnor från hela Dalarna i samband med barnafödande och gynekologiska sjukdomar och/eller gynekologiska besvär. Vården spänner över ett brett område, från utredning och behandling till pre- och postoperativ vård samt vården under den första tiden med det nyfödda barnet. Hos oss vårdas även nyfödda barn som behöver medicinsk vård och/eller särskilda omvårdnadsinsatser. Arbetet präglas av teamarbete, variation och ett nära samarbete mellan olika professioner. BB/Gyn är en del av kvinnokliniken och samarbetar nära med bland annat förlossningen, specialistmödravården och de gynekologiska mottagningarna. Kvinnokliniken är en verksamhet där medarbetare får möta patienter med många olika behov och i olika skeden av livet med en stark gemenskap och ett nära samarbete inom hela kvinnokliniken. ArbetsuppgifterVi söker dig som vill utvecklas som sjuksköterska/barnmorska och få en bred kompetens inom kvinnosjukvård. Tjänsten är ett vikariat med rotation mellan BB- och gynekologiavdelningen, med möjlighet till förlängning eller tillsvidareanställning. Du börjar din anställning inom BB- vård och därefter inskolning inom gynekologi. Genom rotation får du möjlighet att arbeta med patienter i olika skeden av livet och succesivt utveckla din kompetens inom flera delar av kvinnosjukvården. Arbetsuppgifter:På BB vårdar du den nyförlösta mamman och det nyfödda barnet. Arbetet omfattar bland annat:    observation och omvårdnad av mamma och barn    postoperativ vård    amnings stöd    att stödja, vägleda och stärka föräldrar i deras nya roll En viktig del av arbetet är att skapa trygghet och ge familjen kunskap och stöd inför den första tiden tillsammans. På gynekologiavdelningen arbetar du med sedvanliga sjuksköterskeuppgifter inom slutenvård. Här möter du patienter med varierande vårdbehov, bland annat i samband med:    gynekologiska operationer    gynekologisk cancersjukdom    endometrios    graviditetskomplikationer före graviditetsvecka 22+0    abortvårdPå kvällar och nätter under vardagar ansvarar avdelningen även för den gynekologiska jourverksamheten på gynmottagningen. Dit kommer patienter med akuta gynekologiska besvär för bedömning och behandling. Patienter i behov av fortsatt slutenvård läggs in via gynmottagningen eller akutmottagningen.Hos oss får du ett varierat och utvecklande arbete där du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens inom både BB-vård och gynekologisk vård. Kombinationen ger dig värdefull erfarenhet av såväl akut som planerad vård och möjlighet att följa och stödja kvinnor i olika skeden av livet. Arbetet innebär att möta patienter med varierande och ibland snabbt föränderliga vårdbehov.Tillsammans arbetar vi för att erbjuda våra inneliggande patienter en trygg och säker vård med den specialistkompetens som finns inom BB- och gynekologisk vård.Anställningen innebär arbete dag, kväll, helg och natt. Arbetsmodell, period anpassad schemaläggning där du som medarbetare är med och påverkar ditt schema i relation till verksamhetens behov.KvalifikationerKrav:    Legitimerad sjuksköterska och/eller legitimerad barnmorskaMeriterande:    Erfarenhet av BB- och/eller gynekologisk vårdOavsett om du är nyutexaminerad eller har flera års erfarenhet är det viktigaste för oss att du är nyfiken, engagerad och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Vi värdesätter att du     arbetar noggrant och ansvarsfullt     har god samarbetsförmåga     kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt med patienter, närstående och kollegor     bidrar till ett gott teamarbete och är öppen för att lära nytt och dela med dig av dina kunskaperAnsökan    Intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan.    Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via systemet, utan kontakta rekryterande chef direkt    Vi tar interna referenser på nuvarande och tidigare anställda i Region Dalarna    På Att söka jobb hos oss - Region Dalarna kan du läsa mer om Region Dalarna som arbetsgivare, vår värdegrund, arbetsmiljö, förmåner samt vilka kontroller som görs inför anställning. Detta arbete innebär direkt och regelbunden kontakt med barn och/eller ungdomar. Innan erbjudande om anställning kan ske, måste du som sökande uppvisa utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister via ett digitalt registerutdrag alternativt i obrutet kuvert enligt lag 2013:852 eller 2000:873. Mer information finns här: Belastningsregistret - begär utdrag (polisen.se).    Här kan du läsa mer om lön och förmåner som anställd i Region Dalarna: Lön, pension och försäkringar - Region Dalarna    Vi har gjort vårt medieval och avböjer kontakt från sälj- och rekryteringsföretagKontakter fritextFackliga kontaktuppgifterFackförbund - Region Dalarna

jobs.title: Erfaren disponent med indgående kendskab til det tyske transportmarked søges til Bulk Transport A/S
jobs.description:
Vi søger snarest muligt en disponent med erfaring inden for kørsel af gods til Tyskland

Bulk-Transport A/S – en del af Meldgaard Gruppen – disponerer over forvogn/hænger, suge/blæsebiler, tiptrailere, kranbiler, Walking Floor og truck-trailere til palle leveringer. Vi tilbyder alt inden for vognmandskørsel og læsning med egen læssemaskine – vi kører med foderstoffer, træpiller, jord og sand alt efter dit behov. Geografisk dækker vi hele Danmark, og der er kun få transportopgaver, som rækker ud over landets grænser.

Om jobbetVi oplever vækst på det tyske marked og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret disponent, der kan være med til at udvikle og styrke vores aktiviteter i Tyskland.

Om digDu har erfaring som disponent og har siddet med Tyskland. Du lægger vægt på høj service og kvalitet, er omstillingsparat og kan håndtere travle perioder, med mange bolde i luften i et hektisk miljø. Du skal kunne bevare overblikket, samle trådene og stadig bevare den positive tilgang.

Du kan bringe dine faglige kompetencer i spil, og gøre en forskel for vores kunder. Endvidere forventer vi, at du:

  • Er struktureret og har ordenssans
  • Har gennemslagskraft og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Har flair for IT/Navision og Office pakken – vi sørger for oplæring
  • Er en god kollega og en god teamspiller
  • Har godt styr på den tyske geografi 
  • Taler flydende tysk

Hos Bulk-Transport A/S kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn-  og ansættelsesforhold. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. Vi kan også tilbyde personalegoder såsom kantine, fitness, m.m.Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Torben Danielsen på tlf. 2033 7273 eller kørselsleder Jesper Hansen tlf. 2042 7227. Send din ansøgning direkte via Ansøg senest den 20. november 2026. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden som vi modtager dem, og vi lukker søgningen, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering - Changeability and affordability
jobs.description:
PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering – Life-cycle perspectives on system qualities: changeability and affordability

Do you want to contribute to the development of knowledge, insight and solutions that are relevant to society and working life today and in the future?

Power grids and energy installations run for 30–50 years – but the information about how they are actually built is often wrong. Help make long-living systems easy and affordable to update. We are looking for a PhD research fellow within Systems Engineering.

About the position

Do you want to help keep long-living energy and infrastructure systems up to date, changeable and affordable for decades? Join us as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Science and Industry Systems, campus Kongsberg. Start: May 2027 (at the latest August 2027).

You will be part of SFI CELECT – the Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems – whose vision is to do more with less, and faster. The centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, brings together Norway's leading industrial companies and 30 PhD candidates across USN, NTNU and the University of Agder. You will also join the Industrial Research School in Complex Systems (INRESCOS).

Campus Kongsberg sits at the heart of one of Norway's strongest technology clusters, with world-leading companies in maritime, defence, aerospace, energy and subsea technology. Research and industry work side by side – giving you a unique network and strong career opportunities in industry or academia.

The position is a three-year educational position with pure organised research training. A four-year appointment with 25% career-advancing work may be considered.

You must apply for and be admitted to the doctoral programme in Technology (Systems Engineering) within three months of starting. The programme includes courses of about six months (30 ECTS), an independent thesis, research dissemination, a trial lecture and a public defence.

Your supervisors will be Professor Kristin Falk (main supervisor) and Professor Gerrit Muller (co-supervisor). Your workplace will be shared between campus Kongsberg and one or several CELECT partner companies: depending on the project, you will spend between 3 and 30 months located at a company's premises. You are expected to be present at campus or at the company during ordinary working hours.

About the doctoral project

The aim of this PhD is to develop lightweight, AI-supported architecting methods that make long-living systems changeable and affordable – from early architecture decisions to upgrades decades later.

Energy, infrastructure and defence systems run for 30–50 years. Early architecture decisions largely determine how well they can be changed later, and what that costs. Yet changeability and affordability often start as vague requirements, and asset information gets lost through many manual handovers. Without knowing the real configuration in the field, every upgrade becomes slow, costly and risky.

In this PhD you will investigate how lightweight architecting, the digital thread and AI can connect requirements, architecture and operation across the life cycle – and help engineers weigh changeability against life-cycle cost. Questions you could explore: • Where and why are changeability and affordability lost between requirements, operation and maintenance? • How can AI and the digital thread support early trade-offs, and later decisions on upgrades and reinvestment? • How well do such methods transfer between product development, critical infrastructure and defence?

You will help shape the final research questions together with your supervisors and industry partners.

The project is part of SFI CELECT headed by Professor Kristin Falk. Industrial cases will be selected among CELECT partners such as TechnipFMC, Glitre Nett, Herøya Industripark and Forsvarsmateriell. Using industry as your laboratory, you will work alongside engineers and systems architects on real development projects. A research stay abroad may be possible.

This position is one of several related CELECT PhD positions at USN: it focuses on the long life cycle of systems, and complements positions on early design and validation (PhD1.3), early systems integration in systems-of-systems (PhD1.5) and competence development for industry (PhD5.1).

You will be part of the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE). 

 

Duties

  • Complete the doctoral programme up to completion of the doctoral degree within the employment period
  • Conduct high-calibre research within the framework described above
  • Academic publications in high-quality journals and conferences
  • Actively work with companies in an industry-as-laboratory environment, combining qualitative and quantitative research
  • Report progress and deliver outputs to the CELECT centre
  • Participate in the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE)
  • Active involvement in SFI CELECT's doctoral team across NTNU, USN and UiA, including the research school INRESCOS, and participation in common workshops, learning events and courses
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign research and educational institutions
  • Be prepared for changes in your work tasks after appointment
Qualifications

All items are requirements, unless it is specified that they are preferred qualifications.  

  • Master's degree (120 ECTS credits) (or equivalent qualifications) within Systems Engineering, Systems Architecture, mechanical, electrical/energy, industrial or software engineering, or a similar relevant engineering discipline
  • Documented knowledge of relevant methodologies, both quantitative and/or qualitative, at master's level
  • Weighted average grade of B or higher on the master's degree and thesis
  • The master’s thesis must have been submitted for assessment by the application deadline for the position and approved before starting in the position
  • Understanding of and interest in AI/ML and data analysis is preferred
  • Knowledge of requirements engineering, systems architecting, configuration management, digital thread or asset management is preferred
  • Industrial experience from energy systems, power grids or other long-living infrastructure or products, preferably from Norwegian industry, is preferred
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2, is preferred
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills
  • Meet the formal requirements for admission to USN's doctoral programmes and the Faculty of Technology, Natural Sciences and Maritime Sciences' doctoral programme in Technology, with the topic of Systems Engineering, no later than three months after starting in the position

 

Personal qualities

In order to be able to complete a doctoral degree, you need to be able to:

  • demonstrate motivation and potential for research in the field
  • work independently, but also participate in teamwork
  •  work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them
  •  present and discuss your research with other academics
  • get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity
  • show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject area
  • analyse data, assess different perspectives, and draw well-founded conclusions
  • work collaboratively in an industrial setting with the CELECT partners
  • be flexible and open to adjusting the project plan as necessary
  • have the academic skills and personal qualities to be able to complete the doctoral programme within the employment period

 

When assessing applications, particular importance will be attached to 

  • Formal qualifications
  • The personal qualities mentioned above
  • Motivation letter
  • Work experience from Norwegian industry
  • Qualifications and experience in systems architecting, requirements engineering or life-cycle/asset management
Requirements for proficiency in English 

This position requires good English language skills. International applicants must document this with a valid certificate from one of the following tests. Specific requirements regarding grades can be found on our webpage English requirement for programmes and subjects taught in English at USN.

  • TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT)
  • IELTS – International English Language Testing Service 
  • Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) from the University of Cambridge
  • PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic

The following applicants are exempt from the requirements listed above:

  • Applicants with one year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or USA
  • Applicants who have completed a master’s degree with English as the language of instruction in an EU or EEA country
  • Applicants who are exempt based on the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir)’s GSU list (Higher Education Entrance Qualification for foreign applicants)

Applicants from Norway can confirm their English language skills by submitting their upper secondary school diploma.

Requirements for proficiency in Norwegian

The position has no formal requirement for proficiency in Norwegian. Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2 (language levels as defined by HK-dir.), is preferred.

Applicants who wish this to be taken into account must document their language skills in the application (see How to apply).

Requirements regarding a licence and/or security clearance

The applicant must meet the requirements for authorization for restricted. You can read more about security clearance on the websites of the National Security Authority and the Civil Clearance Authority. For the position, an export licence is also required, and the applicant must meet the requirements for this. You can read more about export licences on DEKSA's website.

Motivation letter

Applicants must submit a motivation letter with the application. This should be short and concise, maximum 500 words.

The final project description and work plan will be prepared in consultation with the supervisor(s) during the first three months of the employment period. It is a prerequisite that you complete the project during the employment period.

What we offer
  • Organised research training in a large undertaking with an important social mission
  • Careers advice and guidance throughout the entire doctoral programme. Together we will draw up a career plan that includes the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • An inclusive working environment with ambitious colleagues
  • The opportunity to take Norwegian language courses
  • Salary in accordance with the Norwegian State salary scale for PhD research fellows (position code 1017) NOK 550,800. In special cases, code 1378 may be used. Any further increases in pay grade will be based on length of service in the position
  • Deductions will be made from your salary in order to make statutory contributions to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund on your behalf
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, ensuring favourable pension, insurance and loan schemes
Diversity

We believe that diversity is a resource in our work and learning environment. Different experiences and backgrounds contribute to different perspectives and better solutions to challenges that need to be solved.

We are committed to respecting each other's differences and will facilitate employees with disabilities. We take into account your needs and your situation in different phases of life.

If you find this position interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, disability, cultural background or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in their CV or an immigrant background, we will call at least one applicant in each of these groups for an interview. If you recognize yourself in one of these categories, you can tick the box in our job search portal.

The university aims to recruit more women to PhD positions within the field. If multiple applicants are considered to have equivalent qualifications, a woman will be given priority over a man.

General information

The Appointment Committee for Fellowship Positions (TUS) is the appointing authority for this position. Your competence for the position will be assessed by an expert committee. The expert committee will assess your competence for the position based on the documentation you have registered in Jobbnorge. 

Based on the expert committee’s assessment, relevant applicants will be invited to an interview and to hold a trial lecture. References will also be obtained for relevant candidates. 

Employment at USN is carried out in accordance with the principles set out in the Norwegian Civil Service Act, and the legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services. If your application is considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter legislation, it will be rejected without further consideration.

If you think this position looks interesting and matches your qualifications, you can submit an application electronically by clicking on “Apply for the position” on this page. Here you will need to enter a short application text and information about your relevant education and work experience. In the application text, you must clearly describe your skills and motivation for the position. 

The application must include:

  • Certified diplomas for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees (120 ECTS). The diplomas must be in a Scandinavian language or English
    • Applicants with higher education completed outside Norway must provide documentation that the education has been recognised and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) You must submit your application for approval before the position’s application deadline. Attach a receipt or decision when applying. The approval must be forwarded once available and is a requirement for employment.

    • Language proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish can be documented in the following ways:
      • a high school diploma
      • a diploma from higher education completed in a Scandinavian language
      • a passed language test that documents Norwegian skills at the B2 level, for example the “Norskprøve for innvandrere” or a level 3 Norwegian course at a higher education institution

Er du klar for å gjøre en forskjell i noens hverdag? Vi søker en BPA-assistent til en fast deltidsstilling på Oppdal. Kvinnen du skal bistå er i 30-årene, bor på Oppdal og jobber som interaksjonsdesigner. Hun ønsker seg en trygg, rolig og respektfull samarbeidspartner som ser hva som trenger å gjøres.

Stillingen passer for deg som liker lange vakter og ønsker flere sammenhengende fridager. Arbeidet foregår både i og utenfor hjemmet, og innebærer praktisk bistand som gir kvinnen større frihet og mulighet til å leve hverdagen slik hun ønsker.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som BPA-assistent vil du blant annet bistå med:

  • Bistand ved dusj og toalettbesøk
  • På- og avkledning
  • Bistand ved legging og vekking
  • Matlaging
  • Klesvask og rengjøring
  • Andre praktiske gjøremål i og utenfor hjemmet

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere etter behov. Det er viktig at du møter kvinnen med respekt og bidrar til et godt samarbeid i hverdagen.

Arbeidstid
  • Fast stilling på deltid
  • Lange vakter
  • Flere sammenhengende fridager mellom vaktene
  • Arbeid på Oppdal
Vi ser etter deg som
  • er trygg, rolig og respektfull i møte med andre
  • er praktisk anlagt og klar for å ta i et tak
  • er pålitelig og møter presist
  • er fleksibel og komfortabel med å arbeide i et privat hjem
  • har evne til å se hva som trenger å gjøres
  • har interesse for å bidra til en god og selvstendig hverdag for et annet menneske

Personlig egnethet og god kjemi vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Fast deltidsstilling med lange vakter
  • Fleksibel arbeidshverdag med mulighet for flere sammenhengende fridager
  • Strukturert og grundig opplæring
  • Lønn etter tariff
  • En meningsfull jobb med stor betydning for et annet menneske
  • Et mangfoldig team og en arbeidsgiver som verdsetter relasjon, kvalitet og respekt for den enkeltes selvbestemmelse

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

jobs.title: Partnerships Lead, UK&I
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Partnerships Lead to build and scale Tandem Health's strategic partnerships across the UK. You will play a key role in accelerating our growth by identifying and securing high-impact partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and healthtech platforms.

You'll own the full partnership lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and building senior relationships through to negotiating agreements, launching partnerships and driving commercial value. Working closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams, you'll help unlock new routes to market, expand our distribution and establish Tandem as a leading AI partner to UK healthcare.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute Tandem's UK partnerships strategy, identifying the relationships and channels that will have the greatest impact on our growth.

  • Identify and secure strategic partnerships across the UK healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and specialist clinic networks.

  • Develop relationships with EHR/EMR providers, digital health platforms and complementary technology businesses to unlock new distribution and integration opportunities.

  • Originate and manage partnership opportunities end-to-end, from initial outreach and business development through to commercial negotiations, contracting and launch.

  • Develop compelling partnership propositions and commercial models that create value for both Tandem and its partners.

  • Drive tangible outcomes from partnerships, including revenue generation, customer acquisition, clinician adoption and market expansion.

  • Work closely with sales, product, project delivery, medical operations and marketing teams to ensure successful implementation and maximise the value of strategic partnerships.

  • Represent Tandem at industry events and conferences, building our profile and network across the UK healthcare market.

  • Monitor market developments and identify new opportunities to strengthen Tandem's competitive position and accelerate growth.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ideally within healthcare, healthtech or enterprise technology.

  • Strong understanding of the UK healthcare landscape, including NHS structures, private healthcare and the wider digital health ecosystem.

  • An established network of relevant industry contacts, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior decision-makers.

  • Demonstrable track record of originating and closing complex, high-value commercial partnerships.

  • Experience developing partnership strategies, identifying new routes to market and creating scalable commercial opportunities.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, develop business cases and negotiate sustainable agreements.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging C-suite executives and senior healthcare leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership and ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Collaborative approach and ability to bring together cross-functional teams to deliver results.

  • Genuine interest in AI, healthcare innovation and transforming how healthcare is delivered.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with Head of Sales UK&I

  3. Sales Demo with Country Director UK&I

  4. Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • £800 wellness budget per year

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.

  • Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C++)
jobs.description:
Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto’s technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.The roleYou will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto’s software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform—from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.What you will do
  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
  • Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
  • Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
  • Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
  • Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
  • Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
  • Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
  • Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
  • Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
  • Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms..
What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
  • You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
  • You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.
What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.
  • Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
  • Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
  • Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
  • Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
  • Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
  • Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
  • Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.
Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.Who you areBeyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:
  • Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Take ownership and follow things through.
  • Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
  • Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
  • Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
  • Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.
Why join Robotto?Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:
  • Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
  • Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
  • Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
  • See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
  • Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.
Our hiring processWe want our hiring process to be straightforward, transparent and conversational.1. Introductory conversation with People & CultureA chance for us to learn more about you and for you to learn more about Robotto, the role and what we are looking for.2. Meeting with the Hiring ManagerA deeper conversation about your experience, skills and approach to the role.3. Technical / Role-specific discussionDepending on the position, this may include a technical discussion, practical exercise, case or live scenario relevant to the work you would be doing at Robotto.4. Leadership meetingA conversation with a member of our leadership team to explore mutual fit and give you another opportunity to learn about Robotto and where we are going.5. OfferIf there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.The exact process may vary slightly depending on the role.Interested?If this sounds like an opportunity you would like to explore, we would love to hear from you.Apply through our careers page and tell us a little about yourself, your experience and why Robotto interests you.Equal opportunityAt Robotto, we want to build a team where different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.The roleYou will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).What you will do
  • Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
  • Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
  • Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
  • Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
  • Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
  • Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
  • Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
  • Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.
What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
  • You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
  • If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.
What we are looking forWe are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

  • Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.

  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.
Who you areYou are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.
  • You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
  • You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
  • You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
  • You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
  • You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.
Minds and makers forging ahead together.At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.Our hiring processOur process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment PartnerA chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal EngineerA deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COOA hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.4. OfferIf there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.Why join Robotto?Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.Equal Employment OpportunityRobotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential.
