jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Science and Technology Studies (STS)
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Interdisciplinary Studies of Culture (KULT) is a leading Norwegian centre in (amongst others) the field of Science and Technology Studies (STS). The department falls under the Faculty of Humanities of the Norwegian University of Science and Technology NTNU and is located in Trondheim, Norway. We are currently recruiting a PhD Research Fellow in STS who wants to work at the crossroads of infrastructures, security, resilience, and interdisciplinary work across these fields. 

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD research fellow, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in higher education and research as well as business and administration. 

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will have a daily supervisor at the department, and one or more co-supervisors from across the project team. 

About the project

How do we build a society that is resilient to crises, attacks, and unexpected shocks? A More Resilient Society is a major strategic initiative at NTNU that requires interdisciplinarity and innovative thinking to address complex and socially relevant challenges. A total of 16 PhD candidates will work across faculties and academic communities within the fields of critical societal infrastructure and health preparedness. The aim is to support research that challenges established assumptions and contributes to a safer and more resilient society.  

STRIDE (Synergizing Transport Resilience, Infrastructure, and Defense in Extremes) is one of the projects under the More Resilient Society initiative. STRIDE is a multidisciplinary research project developing a dynamic, multi-risk modeling framework to enhance the resilience of Norway's transport infrastructure against converging climate-driven hazards, such as severe floods and landslides, and geopolitical threats, including targeted sabotage. Moving beyond traditional, brittle "fail-safe" design paradigms, STRIDE operationalizes a "safe-to-fail" approach focused on maintaining critical transport functionality through graceful degradation and rapid recovery across the entire disaster management cycle. As a PhD candidate, you will work within a collaborative, cross-faculty team spanning civil engineering, artificial intelligence, operations research, and science and technology studies.

You will focus on integration of knowledge across academic domains, the operationalization of concepts such as ‘comprehensive resilience’ (Norwegian: totalberedskap) in a multidisciplinary context, and the sociotechnical analysis of infrastructures and their vulnerabilities. 

Duties of the position

You will be offered a position for 4 years as a paid PhD Research Fellow (stipendiat). This will consist of 2,5 years independent research, 0,5 year of courses at PhD level, and 1 year of career-relevant work which may or may not include teaching. More specifically, your duties will be to:

  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out high-quality research within the framework described above
  • Produce academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in several research groups at KULT, notably the newly established group on Security Studies (and the related university-wide research group on Security Narratives), and the longstanding Center for Climate, Energy and the Environment (CLEEN).
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching (dependent on the Department’s needs and opportunities)
  • Other career-promoting work, such as project support and assistance in grant acquisition.

Changes to your work duties may occur after employment, and flexibility is appreciated.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Interdisciplinary Studies of Culture (PHKULT, https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phkult), see also Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a Master's degree in a relevant subject area. Relevant areas include: Science and Technology Studies (STS), fields such as philosophy, history, sociology and anthropology with a distinctly technology-oriented focus, innovation studies and innovation management, and history and philosophy of science (HPS). Within these fields, it is crucial that you demonstrate an affinity with and aptitude for qualitative and interpretive research. We will also consider candidates from the natural and engineering sciences, provided that they can demonstrate affinity and aptitude for humanities and social sciences. 
  • Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than August 2027. Documentation needs to be provided with the application, certifying that this is a realistic expectation (e.g. letter from supervisor). 
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Excellent command of the English language, both written and orally.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

In order to secure a good fit with the project, candidates are strongly recommended to seek informal contact with the envisioned daily supervisor, Govert Valkenburg (see below), in good time before submitting the application, to acquire more detailed information about the project. 

Preferred selection criteria
  • Demonstrable interdisciplinary experience, either within the humanities and social sciences (HSS), or even outside HSS, with fields like engineering, natural science or medical science.
  • Demonstrable collaborative research experience, including possible internships.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian. If this is not the case, willingness to learn will be considered an advantage. 
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. 

The successful candidate will be granted conditional admission to the PHKULT doctoral programme when employed in the PhD research fellow position. It is a prerequisite for continued employment that the requirements for full admission are met within three months, and that you continue to participate in the organized doctoral programme for the remainder of the employment period. For more information about the requirements for full admission, please see Section 6 of the PhD regulations. 

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The application and all required attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no before the deadline. The documents must be in Norwegian, another Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. If you are invited for an interview, you must present certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. Include a diploma supplement if your institution offers one, or otherwise a description of the Higher Education system and its grading scales from the country where the degree was obtained.
  • CV filled out in Jobbnorge
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If the thesis is not in English or a Scandinavian language, add an extended summary in English or Norwegian. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline proposing your approach to the project in terms of research questions, theoretical perspectives and methodological design, as well as a tentativeprogress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Any relevant certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts of, your education has been taken outside Norway, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution does not offer a “diploma supplement”, you must attach information about the grading scale from the education institution. 

We further recommend that you enclose a statement about your education abroad from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir). Follow the link to their web site for more information about how to obtain such a statement: Apply for recognition of foreign higher education. See also NTNU’s web site for documentation requirements for education obtained outside Norway. 

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact research professor Govert Valkenburg, govert.valkenburg@ntnu.no. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Elisabeth Leite, email: elisabeth.leite@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 20.11.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

We conduct research and teaching in two subject areas: equality and diversity, and science and technology studies. The Department has an active research environment with a high proportion of external funding. The Department of Interdisciplinary Studies of Culture is one of six departments in the Faculty of Humanities.

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Denmark
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

jobs.description: Prima omsorg i Norden AB är en assistansanordnare som strävar efter att hålla högsta tänkbara kvalitet på utförandet av assistansen. Vår målsättning är alltid högsta möjliga livskvalitet för de assistansanvändare som valt oss som anordnare. Vägen dit är utbildning och handledning. Det är vi övertygade om. Därför kan du som medarbetare hos Prima Omsorg förvänta dig att få mycket nyttig kunskap och kontinuerlig handledning kring dina arbetsuppgifter.Vår glada och härliga tjej söker nu efter personlig assistent. Dagarna är väldigt varierande i arbetet med henne. Det finns dagar som är mycket lek och skratt och bus men också tillfällen där din roll är att förebygga och hantera frustrationer och problemskapande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att ständigt vara intresserad på hennes mående och vara följsam i olika miljöer. Arbetet ska kännetecknas av att stärka kundens självständighet och självbestämmande. Den vi söker ska vara engagerad och arbeta med ett öppet sinne. Stor merit om du tidigare arbetat på skola med funktionsvariation, varit pedagog eller arbetat i liknade område. Din bakgrund behöver inte nödvändigtvis vara som personlig assistent utan kanske har du arbetat med personer med autismspektrum i annan typ av verksamhet. Du ska vara positiv, uppmärksam, ansvarsfull och lekfull. Med ett stort ansvar att styra och planera dagen samt arbeta med tydlighet. Det är otroligt viktigt att skapa en relation och arbeta efter hennes behov och livsstil. Det skapar förtroende och trygghet för henne.  Kunden har ett stort intresse för att åka buss, tunnelbana och båt. Hon har EP och autism så tidigare erfarenhet av det är meriterande. Du behöver ha följande egenskaper/intressen:•    Tycka om att leka•    Tycka om att hitta på saker•    Kunna behålla lugnet i alla situationer•    Ha barnasinnet och agera lekfullt•    Stabil och trygg i dig själv (skinn på näsan)Är du personen vi söker kommer du vara assistent till en fantastisk tjej med ett stort intresse för skoj och lek. Ett otroligt lärande och utvecklande arbete där möjligheten finns att bli hennes vän. Hon har ett omfattande tillsyns- och omvårdnadsbehov. Vi söker dig som:•    Är uppfinningsrik, motiverande och engagerande.•    Är positiv, lugn, stabil och trygg i dig själv.•    Har autismspecifik kunskap.•    Är uppmärksam, tydlig och följsam i ditt arbetssätt.•    Är ansvarsfull, tålmodig och har stor uthållighet.•    Har stor förmåga att kontrollera och hantera dina egna känslor.•    Ska kunna skriva, förstå och prata flytande svenska då daglig skriftlig dokumentation skerTjänsten innebär tider över hela dygnet. Dag kväll, natt och helg, tjänsten är på cirka 50-80 procent. Som anställd hos Prima Omsorg gäller obligatorisk utbildning och pedagogisk handledning.Innan arbetsstart behöver du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret, det beställer du här: https://polisen.se/Service/Blanketter/Blanketter-belastningsregistret/blankett-4429-LSS-belastningsregistret/

jobs.title: Customer Solution Engineer, Hyvinkää
jobs.description: About the roleIn this role, you will act as a key technical bridge between the customers and the engineering team. You will combine your electrical engineering knowledge with a customer-oriented mindset to solve technical challenges. You will work closely with the sales team to ensure that customized marine solutions meet all technical, cost, and safety requirements.You are offeredYou will join a supportive, tight-knit team with a great sense of humor and highly experienced mentors. This role offers a unique opportunity to see the entire project lifecycle—from sales to delivery—while working on fascinating global marine projects.Work tasksAs a Customer Solution Engineer, you will provide technical expertise to the sales team, understand customer needs, and transform them into optimal engineering solutions for marine vessels. Your focus will be on non-standard projects, managing the technical content from the early engagement phase through delivery.- Translate customer needs into optimal technical specifications and solutions- Participate in customer meetings and provide technical and cost-related support to sales- Create detailed specifications for non-standard marine projects- Coordinate engineering schedules and delivery timelines between the supply line and the customer- Ensure proposed technical solutions comply with marine codes, regulations, and safety standards- Analyze change requirements during project delivery and propose updated solution plans- Conduct occasional site visits to shipyards and vessels for hands-on technical coordination- Conduct site surveys onboard ships for modernization projectsWe are looking for- Degree in Electrical or Automation Engineering- Fluent English skills, both written and spoken- Experience using CAD tools such as AutoCAD or Vertex- Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe and visit shipyard sites- Strong proactive attitude and excellent communication and prioritization skills- Understanding of and interest in modern digital solutionsIt is meritorious if you have- Experience working in the marine, shipyard, or maritime industry- Knowledge of SAP systems- Fluent Finnish skills- Familiarity with French, Italian, or Mandarin ChineseOur recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Production Worker (Chinese-Speaking) - Nummela, Vihti
jobs.description: Wellpack is looking for a technically skilled, Chinese-speaking Production Worker for our client company in Nummela, Vihti.The position is based at an established metal manufacturing facility producing various metal components and assemblies for industrial customers.We are looking for a motivated and technically minded person who enjoys hands-on work and is interested in industrial machinery and manufacturing processes. Previous experience in machine operation, industrial production or other technical fields is highly valued. Comprehensive training will be provided, so previous experience with laser machinery is not required.About the roleYour main responsibility will be operating a Han's Laser machine as part of the factory's production process. Your daily duties will include operating and monitoring the machine, following production instructions and ensuring that work is carried out accurately and safely.The position also involves occasional Chinese-English interpreting and communication support, helping facilitate communication between employees and other personnel at the factory.Depending on production needs, your responsibilities may include other manufacturing tasks, such as assembly work and general production activities.You will work at the factory in Nummela during the morning shift.What we expect from you * Good Chinese language skills and fluent English * Technical skills and practical problem-solving skills * Previous experience or a solid understanding of industrial machinery, manufacturing processes or other technical work * A careful, responsible and safety-conscious approach to work * Willingness to learn new machinery and develop your technical skills * Good communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team * Flexibility to participate in different manufacturing and assembly tasks when neededPrevious experience that we value * Experience operating industrial machinery or production equipment * Technical education or practical experience in mechanical, electrical or other technical fields * Experience operating laser machines, particularly Han's Laser equipment * Experience interpreting or communicating technical instructions between Chinese and EnglishPrevious experience with laser machinery is an advantage, not a requirement. We place greater importance on your technical understanding, practical skills and ability to learn. You will receive comprehensive training for the position.What we offer * Comprehensive training and introduction to the Han's Laser machine and your daily responsibilities * An opportunity to work with industrial technology in an established manufacturing environment * Morning shift work with a regular schedule * Opportunities to develop your technical skills and gain experience in different manufacturing processes * An initial fixed-term employment contract through Wellpack, with the aim of finding a suitable employee for a long-term position * Salary determined according to the applicable collective agreement and your experience * Support from Wellpack throughout your employmentAbout Wellpack and how to applyYou will be employed by Wellpack, a Finnish staffing and recruitment company established in 2013. Wellpack is particularly known as a trusted recruitment partner in the manufacturing and defence industries. We connect skilled employees with quality job opportunities and support employment in Finland.Apply as soon as possible using the Apply button in this job advertisement. Your application will be saved in our recruitment system. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period and fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found.For further information, please contact Wellpack's recruitment team at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager for Renewables Service, Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. Your position As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. Your tasks & responsibilities As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 
  • Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
  • Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
  • Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
  • Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
  • Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
  • Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 
  • Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
  • Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
  • Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
  • Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
  • Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 
Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: ICT-asiantuntija | DigiHelsinki Oy
jobs.description: **Ovatko VLAN, VXLAN, RADIUS, 802.11ax ja 802.1X sinulle tuttua työpäivän sanastoa? Haluaisitko seuraavaksi päästä hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisessa tietoliikenneympäristössä, jossa pääset sekä ratkomaan teknisiä haasteita että kehittämään palveluita eteenpäin?**Etsimme DigiHelsingille osaavaa ja motivoitunutta **ICT-asiantuntijaa** vahvistamaan tietoliikennepalveluidemme tiimiä. Tehtävässä työskentelet LAN- ja WLAN-ympäristöjen parissa ja osallistut niiden ylläpitoon, kehittämiseen ja uudistamiseen yhdessä palveluntuottajakumppanimme kanssa.Pääset mukaan tietoliikenneprojekteihin ja uusien palveluiden käyttöönottoihin, tekemään verkkolaitteiden konfigurointeja ja muutostöitä sekä ratkomaan häiriötilanteita. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, palveluntuottajien ja muiden ICT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa.Tässä tehtävässä pääset käyttämään olemassa olevaa verkko-osaamistasi laajasti ja samalla kehittämään sitä edelleen vaativien tietoliikenneratkaisujen parissa.**Mitä pääset tekemään?****Tehtävän keskeisiin vastuisiin kuuluvat:**- LAN- ja WLAN-verkkojen ylläpito ja kehittäminen - osallistuminen projekteihin ja uusien palveluiden käyttöönottoihin - verkkolaitteiden käyttöönotot, konfiguroinnit ja muutostyöt - tietoliikennepalveluiden häiriötilanteiden selvittäminen ja ratkaiseminen - yhteistyö palvelutoimittajien, asiakkaiden ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa Ensimmäisten kolmen kuukauden aikana olet muun muassa ollut aktiivisesti mukana käynnissä olevassa tietoturvahankkeessa, omaksunut DigiHelsingin sisäiset toimintamallit sekä oppinut tuntemaan yhteistyökumppanit, joiden kanssa olet jo päässyt rakentamaan sidosryhmäyhteistyötä**Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on:**- vahva tietoliikenteen perusosaaminen sekä käytännön kokemusta verkkoympäristöjen parissa - soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava työkokemuksella hankittu osaaminen - kokemusta yritys- tai palveluverkkojen ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä - hyvä LAN- ja WLAN-ratkaisujen sekä TCP/IP-verkkoprotokollien osaaminen - kokemusta verkkojen vianmäärityksestä ja järjestelmällisestä ongelmanratkaisusta - ymmärrystä verkkoturvallisuudesta, pääsynhallinnasta ja tietoturvakäytännöistä - hyvät yhteistyö- ja asiakaspalvelutaidot - sujuva suomen kielen taito sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen riittävä englannin kielen osaaminen **Eduksi katsomme:**- Cisco-verkkojen ja -laitteiden tuntemuksen - alan sertifioinnit, kuten CCNA:n, CCNP:n tai vastaavan - kokemuksen suurten organisaatioiden verkkoympäristöistä - kokemuksen palomuuriympäristöistä, kuten Palo Alto-, Fortinet- tai Cisco-ratkaisuista - runkoverkon teknologioiden, kuten MPLS:n ja BGP:n, tuntemuksen. **Hyvä tietää tehtävästä**Tehtävä edellyttää valmiutta työskennellä Helsingin alueella eri sijainneissa sekä ajoittain iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työajan ulkopuolista työtä voi olla esimerkiksi suunniteltujen käyttökatkojen, asennusten, muutosten ja poikkeustilanteiden yhteydessä. Tehtävään valitulle tullaan teettämään turvallisuusselvitys, minkä hyväksytty todistus on edellytys työsuhteelle.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**DigiHelsingillä pääset rakentamaan uudenlaista digitaalista kaupunkia yhdessä asiantuntevien kollegoiden kanssa. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittää toimintaa ja kasvattaa omaa osaamistasi jatkuvasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.Meitä yhdistää halu olla erinomaisia siinä, mitä teemme, ja kehittyä jatkuvasti paremmiksi. Uteliaisuus, uuden oppiminen ja oman osaamisen aktiivinen ylläpitäminen kuuluvat meillä ammattilaisuuteen. Arvostamme ihmisiä, jotka seuraavat oman alansa kehitystä, etsivät parempia tapoja tehdä asioita ja jakavat osaamistaan myös muille. Meillä saat vastuuta, pääset vaikuttamaan ja viemään asioita suunnitelmista käytäntöön.Meillä teet asiantuntijatyötä joustavassa hybridimallissa, jossa yhdistyvät sujuva yhteistyö toimistolla ja tehokas monipaikkainen työ. Toimistomme sijaitsee urbaanilla Konepajan alueella Vallilassa, erinomaisten kulkuyhteyksien varrella.Panostamme henkilöstömme hyvinvointiin, viihtymiseen ja yhteisöllisyyteen. Tarjoamme kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten Epassin kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointiedut sekä työmatka- ja lounasedun. Rakennamme yhteisöllistä kulttuuria yhteisten tapahtumien ja virkistyshetkien kautta.Palkitsemme henkilöstöämme kulloinkin voimassa olevan palkitsemismallin mukaisesti.**Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus**Arvostamme työyhteisössämme monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Uskomme, että erilaiset kokemukset ja näkökulmat tukevat innovatiivisuutta, hyvinvointia ja tuloksellisuutta. Kannustamme henkilöitä erilaisista taustoista hakemaan meille töihin.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: About the roleBittium SafeMove Comms is a quantum-safe, end-to-end encrypted communications platform for government agencies, defence forces, and critical infrastructure organisations. It covers voice, video, and messaging on Android, iOS, and Windows, and is built on a zero-trust architecture that customers can run on-premises, in air-gapped networks, in the cloud, or in isolated tactical environments.Within our Security business, we are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior Full Stack Developer to join Bittium Wireless Oy and the team that develops, deploys, and maintains SafeMove Comms across our entire customer base. The position is based in Oulu, Finland, and offers a hybrid working model. You will work on both client and server, and you'll have real influence on how the product evolves. When the situation calls for it, you'll take the technical lead, both within the team and together with our customers.We are a small team, and we see that as a real opportunity for you. You'll get to take ownership early, have a direct say in technical decisions, and learn faster than you would in a larger organisation, across clients, servers, security, and customer work. With that opportunity comes responsibility: you'll own what you build, and you should be comfortable handling the pressure that comes with work where our customers' security depends on us.What you'll do- Develop SafeMove Comms desktop and mobile clients as well as server-side components- Solve demanding integration and architecture challenges without losing sight of the user experience- Take ownership of problems and drive them to working solutions, independently or together with the team- Lead technical discussions with the team and customers when needed- Take part in deploying and maintaining the product in demanding customer environmentsWhat we expect from you- Solid experience in software development across both client-side and server-side technologies- Strong software development skills and an agile mindset- Good collaboration skills and the ability to solve demanding problems independently- A willingness to take ownership and provide technical direction within the team and beyond- Experience with desktop development using JavaScript/TypeScript and React, or with Android development- Experience with server-side technologies such as Linux, Java, SQL databases, and Nginx- Fluent Finnish and EnglishWe especially value- Knowledge of network security- Knowledge of the Signal Protocol or similar end-to-end encryption protocols- Knowledge of PKI and certificate management- Experience in iOS developmentNice to have- Broader expertise in information security and cryptography- Experience with Rust, Redux, or ElectronInterested?Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.About BittiumBittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

jobs.title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
jobs.description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 14:00–22:00 or 16:00–22:00
  • Night shifts: 23:00–06:00

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?
  • Flexible work: Choose when and where you want to work, depending on available shifts and assignments.
  • Earn extra money: Perfect if you’re studying or looking to boost your income ahead of the holidays.
  • Get valuable experience: Develop your skills in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Opportunities for the future: Show us what you can do and you may have the chance to move into a permanent position.
  • Great benefits: Including pension and holiday pay.
Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who:

  • Are reliable, motivated, and ready to get stuck in.
  • Bring positive energy and enjoy being part of a team.
  • Are comfortable working independently when needed.
  • Are physically fit and able to handle tasks involving heavy lifting.

Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not a requirement. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter most!

Be part of the Black Friday rush!

Peak season is approaching fast, and we’re getting ready for the busiest time of the year. Join the HumanizeR team in Ringsted, gain valuable experience, and earn extra money while helping keep Denmark’s parcels moving.

Ready to get started? Apply today and join us for peak season!

jobs.title: Night Shift In the Inbound department at Imerco!
jobs.description:
Are you a night owl looking for a temporary warehouse job where you can earn money and gain valuable experience? Do you enjoy practical, hands-on work and prefer working at night? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and reliable warehouse employees to join the inbound department at Imerco, one of Scandinavia’s largest merchandise companies. As we head into the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, we need dedicated night shift workers to help ensure that incoming goods are received and handled efficiently.

The job

Your working hours will be from 23:00 to 07:00, Monday to Friday. The job starts in week 45 or 46 and includes training shifts. It is important that you are available to start during these weeks and can work through to the end of December.

It will be approximately full-time from November. This is a great opportunity to earn extra money while gaining valuable warehouse experience.

Your tasks in the inbound department include:

  • Receiving incoming shipments

  • Opening, lifting, and moving boxes

  • Unloading pallets

  • Working with the Autostore

We are looking for candidates who enjoy working at night and can stay focused and productive throughout their shifts. You should be comfortable with physical work, routine tasks, and a busy warehouse environment.

Additionally, we expect you to:

  • Have experience working in a warehouse – experience with an Autostore is an advantage

  • Be comfortable working night shifts from 23:00 to 07:00

  • Prefer practical, hands-on, and structured work

  • Be physically fit and able to stay active throughout the shift

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Communicate well in either English or Danish

We offer valuable warehouse experience during the busy Black Friday and Christmas season, along with the opportunity to earn money during the winter period. You will become part of a friendly and supportive team, where tasks are clearly defined and workflows are well structured.

Working hours, salary and location

  • Working hours: Monday to Friday, 23:00–07:00

  • Start: Week 41, including two consecutive training shifts

  • Employment period: Through the end of December

  • Salary: DKK 156.34 per hour, including Fritvalgskonto

  • An ekstra 35 kr/hour when working the night shift

The warehouse is located in Vallensbæk, with good bus connections, nearby train stations, and free parking available.

Ready to join the night shift team?Apply today! We conduct recruitment on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Work in the evenings and earn extra – Join Imerco’s Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary evening job in November and December? Do you enjoy being physically active, working at a fast pace, and being part of a great team? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for the evening shift at Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4-5 evening shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6. The training will take place in the beginning of November.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

Detta söker vi:

We are looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys routine-based and independent work

  • Has a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Is reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for their shifts

  • Is physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the shift

  • Has good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Is available for 4 evening shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Is available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking, dependable, and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We offer an exciting temporary evening position in a well-established retail company, where you will become part of a friendly and supportive team. You will gain valuable warehouse experience, work in a structured environment with clearly defined tasks, and have the opportunity to earn extra money during the busy Christmas season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour, in addition to which evening and weekend supplements are provided.

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description: Värderar du närhet, att växa och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för alla som bor och verkar i Huddinge kommun? Då erbjuder vi mängder av karriärmöjligheter i en välfungerande och växande kommun med både natur och storstadspuls runt hörnet. Hos oss känner du dig trygg, delaktig och stolt när vi med kraft gör skillnad, varje dag. I Huddinge kommun arbetar vi för att skapa ett hållbart samhälle, där natur, teknik och god service samspelar. Huddinge är en stor Stockholmskommun med cirka 6 400 medarbetare och fler än 110 000 invånare.Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen.Huddinge kommun arbetar för att vara en trygg, rättssäker och professionell verksamhet. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi därför komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller och begära registerutdrag i slutskedet av vissa rekryteringar. Om du blir aktuell för detta får du tydlig information och möjlighet att lämna ditt samtycke innan kontrollen genomförs.Socialförvaltningen ansvarar för individ- och familjeomsorg, äldreomsorg och omsorg för personer med funktionsnedsättningar. Vi arbetar förebyggande med stöd, insatser och myndighetsutövning till barn, ungdomar, familjer, vuxna, äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning.Vårt uppdrag är att öka individers förutsättningar att leva under så bra levnadsvillkor som möjligt samt att stärka individer till att leva ett självständigt liv. Vi är en socialtjänst som ligger i framkant i preventionsarbetet och i omställningsarbetet till en än mer lätt tillgänglig och kunskapsbaserad socialtjänst.1 plats(er). Om arbetsplatsenEnheten är en servicebostad som ligger i centrala Huddinge. Det är ett boende för 12 vuxna personer med olika funktionsnedsättningar så som måttlig intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, funktionsnedsättningar inom autismspektrumet och andra neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar. Det förekommer utmanande beteende och psykiatrisk tilläggsproblematik på enheten. Risk för hot och våld kan förekomma. Vi arbetar med individen i centrum och är noga med att kvalitetssäkra de insatser vi ger så att brukarna kan leva ett så självständigt och gott liv som möjligt. Enheten möter komplexa behov och utmanande beteende, sucididrisk kan förekomma.På enheten arbetar stödassistenter, boendestödjare och två stödpedagoger. Enheten delar enhetschef och biträdande enhetschef med tre andra närliggande serviceboenden. De olika enheterna har ett nära samarbete, t.ex. täcker enheterna för varandra vid frånvaro och stöttar vid ensamarbete.ArbetsuppgifterSom arbetsledare arbetar du gemensamt med enhetschef, biträdande enhetschef och ansvarar tillsammans för att intentionerna i aktuell lagstiftning följs. I samråd med enhetschef och biträdande enhetschef arbetar du med ledning, administration, planering, samordning och uppföljning av verksamheten. Den främsta uppgiften är att planera och strukturera det dagliga arbetet. Arbetsledare agerar som förebild och deltar i enhetens samtliga arbetsuppgifter. Du ger medarbetarna stöd och återkoppling i deras dagliga arbete. I din roll som arbetsledare arbetar du på enheten med stöd gentemot brukarna men kommer också ha administrativa arbetsuppgifter.Tjänsten innebär arbetsuppgifter i verksamhetssystem för t.ex. schemaläggning, fakturor, beställningar och dokumentation.Vi erbjuder våra brukare ett individuellt anpassat stöd och inflytande för brukarna i verksamheten är en självklarhet. Det är viktigt att du förstår värdet av en hjälpande professionell relation som bygger på respekt för individens självbestämmande och integritet. Tjänsten är på heltid. Du är schemalagd på enheten och tjänsten innebär arbete dag, kväll och varannan helg. Schemat kan komma att ändras vid behov.Din profilVi söker en flexibel, stabil och tydlig ledare som är en bra på att samarbeta och coacha. Du ska kunna planera och strukturera ditt arbete självständigt, och ha förmåga att prioritera bland dina arbetsuppgifter. Enheten har behov av en tydlig och närvarande ledare som förmår att skapa engagemang vid förändringar och utvecklingsarbete.Du ska ha förmåga att skapa och upprätthålla goda relationer med interna och externa kontakter. Du behöver ha intresse och erfarenhet av att utveckla verksamheter med utgångspunkt i brukarens självbestämmande och med respekt för brukarens integritet.Krav för tjänsten    Du har aktuell kunskap kring målgruppen som bor på servicebostad och de levnadsvillkor som personer med funktionsnedsättningar lever i. jobs.title: Master Thesis: Recycled aluminium in battery casing application – microstru
jobs.description: This master thesis is part of the Net Zero Impact Innovation-funded BAALSCRAP project (BAttery casings from ALuminum alloys with low carbon emissions produced from SCRAP), which aims to enable the production of battery cell housings from recycled aluminum scrap and thereby support the transition towards a circular and net-zero automotive industry. The project investigates how alloying elements and impurities originating from recycled feedstock affect manufacturing processes and material performance. The thesis will focus on the relationship between microstructure and weld properties of recycled aluminum alloys for battery casing applications. The work will involve detailed characterization of welds using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), with emphasis on precipitates, intermetallic particles, segregation, porosity, cracking, and other welding-related defects. The influence of recycled alloying elements and residual impurities on weld quality and performance will be assessed and correlated with material properties. In addition, property calculations (e.g. crack susceptibility) will be used to predict weld performance as a function of alloy composition. The modeling results will be compared with the experimental observations to improve the understanding of microstructure evolution during welding and to help explain the relationship between alloy chemistry, weld microstructure, and weld performance.Desired Qualifications We are looking for a highly motivated Master's student in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Materials Engineering, or a related field. The ideal candidate has an interest in experimental research and materials characterization, with a particular focus on microstructure-property relationships in metallic materials. Experience or coursework in microscopy, welding metallurgy, aluminum alloys, or electron microscopy is advantageous but not required.Additional InformationThe project is planned to be carried out during the spring semester of 2027 at Swerim in Stockholm. Upon successful completion of the Master's thesis (30 ECTS credits), Swerim will provide a compensation of SEK 50,000. ContactFor further information about the project, please contact: Shirin Nouhi, shirin.nouhi@swerim.se   Application Please apply using the application link below no later than 15 November 2026. Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the thesis position may be filled before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Operator 3-ploegensysteem
jobs.description:
Word jij de nieuwe productie operator die wij zoeken? Ben jij een gedreven werknemer met technisch talent die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt? Heb je oog voor kwaliteit én hou je van teamwork? En ook van frietjes...? Dan ben jij de operator die we zoeken!

Als operator ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de productie van heerlijke aardappelproducten.Jij zorgt ervoor dat de productie soepel verloopt: van het instellen van machines tot het bewaken van kwaliteit en hygiëne. Jouw technische inzicht en nauwkeurigheid maken het verschil!

Hoe ziet je dagelijkse takenpakket er uit?

  • Je bedient en controleert de computergestuurde productiemachines. Je stelt de machines in en bouwt ze om bij product wissels. 
  • Je grijpt in bij storingen en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen.
  • Je voert kwaliteitscontroles uit en zorgt voor nauwkeurige registratie van deze gegevens. 
  • Je reinigt machines en draagt bij aan het onderhoud en de organisatie van de werkplek. 

In welk team kom je terecht? 

  • Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en enthousiast team.
  • Samen zorgen jullie voor topkwaliteit én een goede sfeer op de werkvloer. 
  • Samenwerking, innovatie en plezier tijdens het werk staan centraal! 
  • Je zoekt een voltijdse job en bent bereid om in een 3-ploegenstelsel te werken (morgen-nacht-middag).
  • Je houdt van werken met moderne computergestuurde machines.
  • Je hebt eerder ervaring met het werken in een ploegensysteem
  • Je bent een teamspeler.
  • Nauwkeurigheid en kwaliteit draag je hoog in het vaandel.

jobs.title: Magazijnier wisselstukken (Lembeke)
jobs.description:
Als magazijnier wisselstukken ben je verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren en beheren van het volledige wisselstukkenmagazijn samen met jouw collega. Hierdoor garandeer je de continuïteit van onze plant en productie installaties.

Takenpakket:

  • Je zorgt voor een correcte administratieve opvolging van alle magazijnactiviteiten in Ultimo en SAP.

  • Je ontvangt en controleert de leveringen, voert orderpickingen uit, en zorgt voor een goede verzending van de goederen.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede en veilige stockering van de wisselstukken en verbruiksmaterialen.

  • Je biedt ondersteuning aan de techniekers en externe partners bij materiaaluitgifte, retours en urgente aanvragen.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de binnengekomen goederen en tooling.

  • Je vraagt offertes aan, vergelijkt deze, plaatst bestellingen en volgt deze op.

  • Je volgt de facturatie op in SAP.

  • Je maakt artikelfiches aan en onderhoudt deze.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het goed gebruik en basisonderhoud van de TD-opslaginfrastructuur.

  • Je analyseert regelmatig vastgestelde afwijkingen.

  • Je rapporteert aan de technical supervisor van het preventief onderhoud.

  • Je werkt in een dagploeg.

  • Je bent proactief en plichtsbewust, je volgt de veiligheidsregels en volgt deze ook op.

  • Je bent administratief sterk, nauwkeurig, analytisch en hebt een goede kennis van MS Office.

  • Je bezit minstens over een diploma Technisch Secundair Onderwijs.

  • Ervaring met magazijnwerking en een eerste ervaring met aankoop is een pluspunt.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en communiceert (zowel intern als extern) op een open en transparante manier.

  • Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands en een basiskennis van het Engels.

jobs.title: Student Tearoom medewerker weekdagen
jobs.description:
Voor een trendy decoratiezaak in Hasselt zijn we op zoek naar extra medewerkers in de bijhorende tearoom. Wil jij graag klanten bedienden, tafels indekken, borden uitdragen, meehelpen aan de afwas? 

Als medewerker van onze tearoom ben je het gezicht van de zaak. Je ontvangt onze gasten met een glimlach, neemt bestellingen op en serveert deze uit. Daarnaast help je mee in de keuken met afwassen.

Ook houd je de tearoom netjes en help je mee met opruimen en schoonmaken.

 

Jouw taken:

  • Ontvangen en bedienen van gasten
  • Opnemen en serveren van bestellingen
  • Zorgen voor een nette en gezellige tearoom
  • Kassawerkzaamheden

 

 

 

 

  • Je hebt ervaring in de horeca! Je weet wat van je verwacht wordt. 
  • Je hebt een onberispelijk voorkomen.
  • Je bent beschikbaar tijdens de week.
  • Het leuke is, je werkt tussen 9u en 18u30!

jobs.title: Technieker productiehal 2-ploegen - meteen vast contract!
jobs.description:
Ben jij een techneut met een passie voor het fixen van complexe machineproblemen? Wil je een onmisbare schakel zijn in de productie van voedingsmiddelen? Sluit je bij ons aan en maak het verschil!

Als Technieker productiemachines ben jij de held die snel en effectief technische problemen oplost en onze productielijnen weer soepel laat draaien. Je werkt aan machines die dagelijks zorgen voor de productie van heerlijke en verse smeersalades, een essentieel product in ons assortiment. Bij ons krijg je de kans om je technische kennis en probleemoplossend vermogen in te zetten in een uitdagende en dynamische omgeving. Klaar om de motor te zijn achter de productie van smeersalades die onze klanten elke dag vers en smakelijk bereiken? 

Als technieker van ons machinepark sta je samen met je collega's van de technische dienst in voor de volgende taken: 

  • Storingen oplossen aan productiemachines om stilstanden te vermijden
  • Controles uitvoeren van de energievoorzieningen zodat de goede werking gegarandeerd word
  • Een preventief onderhoudsplan opstellen met bijhorende taken en deze opvolgen
  • Rapporteren aan hoofd technische dienst
  • Je stemt af met dienst planning over het uitvoeren van preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden 
  • Je begeleidt externe techniekers 
  • Je stemt af met de shiftleider productie i.v.m. werken tijdens interventies
  • Je contacteert leveranciers voor bestellingen van onderdelen
  • Je werkt met een beurtrol in het weekend ter permanentie
  • Kennis van mechanica, elektriciteit, elektromechanica, pneumatiek, hydraulica
  • PC-vaardigheden, courante MS Office 
  • Kennis van las-, slijp- en freeswerken

jobs.title: Junior Business Developer
jobs.description:
In deze rol bouw je actief mee aan de groei van een partner- en dealernetwerk in Benelux, Noord-Frankrijk en West-Duitsland. Je combineert marktanalyse en strategie met echte prospectie: je spot kansen, opent deuren bij nieuwe partners en zet samenwerkingen om in duurzame resultaten. Je werkt heel mobiel, veel onderweg, en als je niet op de baan bent, werk je vanuit kantoor (Massenhoven).  Wat je concreet doet
  • Nieuwe partners (dealers/concept stores/installateurs/verwerkers) identificeren en actief prospecteren
  • Markt, cijfers en dekking analyseren en vertalen naar een groeiplan
  • Een sales pipeline opbouwen en opvolgen (o.a. via CRM)
  • Onderhandelen en afspraken vastleggen, en nadien partnerrelaties verder uitbouwen
  • Aanwezig zijn op vakbeurzen en events (regelmatig ook weekendwerk)
  • In de opstartfase ligt de focus vaak eerst op Nederland, later breder in NL/FR/DE
Over het bedrijfVoor een groeiend Belgisch productiebedrijf met een sterke reputatie in premium maatwerkproducten zoeken we een commerciële versterking. Het bedrijf combineert vakmanschap en kwaliteit met een nuchtere, no-nonsense aanpak en werkt via een partner- en dealernetwerk in binnen- en buitenland. Je komt terecht in een stabiele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen, waar samenwerking, initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid centraal staan.
  • Je hebt een bachelor/master of gelijkwaardige ervaring 
  • Schoolverlaters welkom
  • Je hebt een duidelijke huntermentaliteit: prospectie schrikt je niet af
  • Je spreekt Nederlands, Frans en Engels (Duits is een sterke troef/meerwaarde)
  • Je kan vlot schakelen tussen analyse/strategie en actie/resultaat
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, communiceert professioneel en bouwt snel vertrouwen op
  • Je bent flexibel in planning en verplaatsingen

jobs.title: Allround technieker: Filterinstallaties
jobs.description: Ontdek een uitdagende technische functie met veel afwisseling in het installeren en onderhouden van mobiele filterinstallaties.Bij onze klant werk je als allround technieker aan mobiele filterunits met actieve kool. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het plaatsen, onderhouden en herstellen van deze installaties bij industriële klanten. Je combineert technisch vakmanschap met zelfstandigheid en klantcontact in een afwisselende werkdag.- Onderhouden, inspecteren en herstellen van mobiele filterinstallaties  - Monteren en demonteren van leidingen, flenzen, kleppen, dichtingen en koppelingen  - Assisteren bij het vullen en ledigen van filterunits en uitvoeren van technische tests  - Installeren van filters bij klanten, zorgen voor correcte aansluiting en ondersteuning bij ingebruikname  - Uitvoeren van technische interventies en gericht zoeken naar oplossingen bij storingen  - Flexibel inspelen op dringende interventies bij verschillende klanten en werven  - Beschikbaar zijn voor noodoproepen indien nodig  - Meedenken over technische verbeteringen en werken volgens veiligheids- en kwaliteitsnormen  Je werkt vanuit Antwerpen en Kallo en bezoekt regelmatig klanten op locatie. Je krijgt een zelfstandige rol waarin je technische kennis en probleemoplossend vermogen centraal staan.Klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een technische functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling? Solliciteer vandaag nog — we kijken ernaar uit je te leren kennen!

jobs.title: Product Owner OSS/BSS
jobs.description:
Product Owner OSS/BSS

Votre travail a un impact direct sur la sécurité des citoyens

À propos d’ASTRID

ASTRID est l’unique réseau de télécommunication des services de secours en Belgique (police, pompiers, ambulances). Nos systèmes garantissent des communications fiables et sécurisées dans ces situations critiques où chaque seconde compte.

Votre mission

En tant que Product Owner OSS/BSS, vous êtes responsable de l’évolution de plateformes stratégiques de billing, provisioning, CRM et monitoring.

Vous êtes le lien entre utilisateurs, équipes techniques et fournisseurs, et vous définissez la direction du produit (roadmaps, priorités, pilotage…)

Concrètement, vous :

  • Définissez la vision, la roadmap et les priorités des plateformes OSS/BSS
  • Traduisez les besoins en solutions concrètes (user stories, priorités)
  • Assurez la coordination entre stakeholders internes et externes
  • Contribuez au delivery des évolutions (c’est là que la gestion de projet devient votre allié)

Ce qui rend ce job intéressant

  • Impact sociétal tangible : Les systèmes que nous développons et améliorons soutiennent l’infrastructure de communication des services d’urgence et de sécurité en Belgique. L’impact de votre travail est donc directement perceptible.
  • Véritable ownership produit : nos Products Owners contribuent réellement à définir l’orientation de systèmes OSS/BSS stratégiques essentiels pour les services d’ASTRID.
  • Grande autonomie : Le rôle offre beaucoup de liberté pour définir les priorités, proposer des améliorations, challenger les parties prenantes et construire la roadmap. Nous avons besoin de vos idées.
  • Environnement complexe et stimulant : Dans ce département, nous travaillons à l’intersection des télécoms, de l’IT et des utilisateurs. Cela implique des technologies, fournisseurs et groupes d’utilisateurs très variés, ce qui rend le poste beaucoup plus riche qu’un rôle de Product Owner classique.
  • Notre Culture : La flexibilité, l’excellence, l’empathie et la motivation sont au cœur de notre manière de travailler. 

Profil

  • Vous bénéficier d’une expérience OSS/BSS ou dans des environnements IT complexes similaires (systèmes de monitoring, billing, provisionning ou CRM)
  • Vous possédez un regard analytique et du sens produit indispensable pour traduire les besoins utilisateurs en requirements clairs
  • Les aspects techniques n’ont pas de secrets pour vous : vous devez pouvoir collaborer avec les administrateurs systèmes, architectes, fournisseurs, management en toute connaissance de cause
  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion des parties prenantes et capables de prioriser : vous êtes le responsable de votre produit et devez aligner les intérêts de diverses parties prenantes
  • Vous communiquez de manière fluide en français et néerlandais avec un anglais technique

jobs.title: CHAUFFEUR C PERSWAGEN
jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Ben jij een krak in cijfers én heb je voeling met de bouwsector?

Krijg je energie van het analyseren van data en het optimaliseren van processen?

Wil je mee je schouders zetten onder uitdagende projecten die écht het verschil maken?

Lees dan snel verder!

Voor een bedrijf dat voornamelijk actief is in civiele werken, renovatie, nieuwbouw van bruggen,... zijn wij op zoek naar een Quantity Surveyor!

Een greep uit jouw takenpakket:

  • Je controleert en valideert hoeveelheden en uitgevoerde werken.

  • Je weet hoe je een werf financieel in de hand houdt

jobs.title: Ploegbaas Bekisting
jobs.description:
Werk je graag mee op de werf én neem je tegelijk graag de touwtjes in handen?

Heb je ervaring met bekistingswerken?

Ben je op zoek naar een stabiele job met veel afwisseling en dit in een hecht team?

Lees dan snel verder!

Voor een bedrijf dat voornamelijk actief is in civiele werken, renovatie, nieuwbouw van bruggen,... zijn wij op zoek naar een Meewerkende Ploegbaas bekisting!

Een greep uit jouw takenpakket:

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de bekistingswerken vlot, veilig en volgens planning verlopen.

jobs.title: Wegenwerker- Oost Vlaanderen
jobs.description:
Werken op unieke werven doorheen heel Vlaanderen?

Hou je van fysiek werk, afwisseling en werken in open lucht? Dan is dit iets voor jou.

Voor een bedrijf met werven doorheen heel Vlaanderen, zijn wij op zoek naar een Wegenwerker.

Samen met je team lever je vakwerk af en bouw je mee aan verschillende indrukwekkende werven.

jobs.title: Logistiek- Technisch verantwoordelijke bouw
jobs.description:
Voor een bedrijf regio Zwijndrecht zijn wij opzoek naar een logistiek verantwoordelijke die heel wat kennis heeft. Dit bedrijf is zeer ambitieus met een sterke visie in de waterbouwkunde, staalbouw en bodemsaneringen in zowel België als Nederland. Ze voeren vooral projecten uit voor de overheid en privébedrijven.

Samen met jouw team van techniekers en mechaniekers zorg je ervoor dat al het materieel tijdig wordt voorzien van het nodige onderhoud, keuringen en inspecties. Je staat in voor de organisatie en opvolgingen van alle herstellingen.

Als logistiek verantwoordelijke zien u taken er als volgt uit:

  • Je werkt operationeel vanop het kantoor te Zwijndrecht
  • Het aankopen van materieel en nieuwe machines
  • Het tijdig organiseren, begeleiden en opvolgen van keuringen voor het rollend en varend materieel, hijsmiddelen, elektrische toestellen en werfinstallaties
  • Samen met jouw team zorg je voor het periodiek en curatief onderhoud van de verschillende machines
  • Je bereidt de investeringsdossiers voor en koppelt regelmatig terug naar het managementteam
  • Je bent in het bezit van een Bachelor of Master diploma elektromechanica of werktuigkunde met minstens 5jaar ervaring
  • Je hebt een talent voor organiseren en het stellen van de juiste prioriteiten
  • Je bent in het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs B

jobs.title: Calculator
jobs.description:

Ons bedrijf is zeer ambitieus met een sterke visie in de waterbouwkunde, staalbouw en bodemsaneringen in zowel België als Nederland. We voeren vooral projecten uit voor de overheid en privébedrijven.

jobs.title: Allround arbeider waterbouw
jobs.description:
Heb jij graag variatie in jouw werk, gaande van werken met een bandenkraan, lassen, branden, monteren en zoveel meer?

Los jij graag kleine mechanische defecten op en ga jij steeds op zoek naar de beste en de meest veilige oplossing?

Voor een bedrijf regio Zwijndrecht zijn wij opzoek naar een allround arbeider waterbouw die heel wat kennis heeft. Dit bedrijf is zeer ambitieus met een sterke visie in

de waterbouwkunde, staalbouw en bodemsaneringen in zowel België als Nederland. Ze voeren vooral projecten uit voor de overheid en privébedrijven.

Door jouw enthousiasme en creativiteit ben jij dé persoon die een meerwaarde betekent voor elke werf!

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

jobs.title: Werkvoorbereider- waterbouw en bodemsaneringen
jobs.description:
Ben jij enthousiast om mee te bouwen aan unieke waterbouwprojecten?

Heb je zin om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen in een uitgebreid team van ingenieurs?

Lees dan snel verder!

Voor een bedrijf regio Zwijndrecht zijn wij opzoek naar een Werkvoorbereider!

Dit bedrijf is zeer ambitieus met een sterke visie in de waterbouwkunde, staalbouw en bodemsaneringen in zowel België als Nederland. Ze voeren vooral projecten uit voor de overheid en privébedrijven.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor alle aankoopvoorbereidingen
  • Je denkt mee over de uitvoeringswijze en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met de projectleiders en de calculatiedienst
  • Je bent in het bezit van een Masterdiploma Bouwkunde

jobs.title: VERHUIZER| VILVOORDE| SNELLE OPSTART
jobs.description:
