* Eigenständige Durchführung von Schulungen/Workshops

* Mitwirkung bei nationalen / internationalen Messen, Kongressen und Veranstaltungen

Dein Profil:

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege

* Ein Quereinstieg aus weiteren Bereichen des Gesundheitswesens (z.B. Physiotherapie) ist möglich

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung

* Erfahrung in einem vergleichbaren Aufgabengebiet im Verkauf (Handel, Dienstleistung) ist von Vorteil

* sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

* Routinierter Umgang mit dem MS Office (insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel)

* Professionelles Verhalten am Telefon und in der Korrespondenz mit Kunden

* Kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit

* Selbstmanagement-Kompetenz und ein hoher Einsatzwille runden Ihr Profil ab

* Reisebereitschaft mit Übernachtung

* Exzellente Präsentationsfähigkeiten

Wir bieten Dir:

* Ein strukturiertes Onboarding Konzept, interne Schulungen und Produkttrainings

* Corporate Benefits Portal

* Persönliche Weiterentwicklung in einem internationalen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

* Dienstauto - auch zur Privat Nutzung

* Langfristiger Arbeitsplatz in einem krisensicheren Unternehmen

* Chancengleichheit und Diversität

* Eine marktkonforme Bezahlung in Abhängigkeit von Deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung ab € 2.800 brutto (All-In Vertrag). Zusätzlich zum attraktiven Gehalt bieten wir ein leistungsorientiertes Bonussystem, das Dir die Möglichkeit gibt, Dein Einkommen durch persönliche Erfolge und Teamleistung zu steigern. Gerne tauschen wir uns bei einem persönlichen Gespräch über Dein Gehalt aus.

Über Arjo

Wir bei Arjo sind der Meinung, dass die Förderung der Bewegungsfreiheit im Gesundheitswesen eine wesentliche Voraussetzung für eine qualitativ hochwertige Pflege ist. Unsere Produkte und Lösungen sind so konzipiert, dass sie einen sicheren und würdevollen Umgang mit Patienten, medizinischen Betten, persönlicher Hygiene, Desinfektion, Diagnostik und der Prävention von Druckverletzungen und venösen Thromboembolien ermöglichen. Mit mehr als 6500 Mitarbeitern weltweit und 65 Jahren Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Patienten und medizinischem Fachpersonal setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Gesundheit von Menschen mit Mobilitätsproblemen zu verbessern.

jobs.title: Manager CTO Office
jobs.description:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

jobs.title: Marketing Koordinator til MyCruise (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, initiativrig og god til at holde mange bolde i luften? 

Brænder du for marketing, og trives du med at skabe overblik, koordinere kampagner og få mennesker til at arbejde godt sammen? 

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Marketing Koordinator til vores marketingteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse. 

Stillingen er et 9-måneders barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. 

Som Marketing Koordinator får du en central rolle i at koordinere vores marketingaktiviteter på tværs af Danmark, Norge, Sverige og UK. 

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores kampagneansvarlige, lokale salgsteams og specialister inden for blandt andet paid media, sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, grafisk produktion og e-commerce. 

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og sørge for, at vores kampagner og marketingaktiviteter bliver gennemført til tiden og i høj kvalitet. 

Du bliver en del af et marketingteam med mange forskellige opgaver, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og har plads til både gode idéer og godt humør. 

Om jobbet 

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores marketingkampagner hænger sammen på tværs af kanaler og markeder. 

Du kommer blandt andet til at: 

  • Koordinere marketingkampagner på tværs af teams, kanaler og samarbejdspartnere. 

  • Omsætte kampagnebriefs til konkrete opgaver og holde styr på deadlines, materialer og leverancer. 

  • Sikre tæt dialog mellem marketing og de lokale salgsteams om behov og kampagner. 

  • Koordinere versionering, oversættelser og lokal tilpasning af nyhedsbreve og øvrigt marketingmateriale. 

  • Assistere med tekstforfatning, korrektur, nyhedsbreve og lettere indholdsopgaver. 

  • Koordinere indhold og materialer til websites, sociale medier og annoncering. 

  • Hjælpe med dokumentation og afrapportering af partnerkampagner. 

  • Indsamle kampagneresultater og bidrage til evaluering og forbedring af kommende aktiviteter. 

  • Bidrage med idéer og praktisk hjælp til øvrige marketingaktiviteter efter behov. 

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige koordinering, men arbejder tæt sammen med vores kampagneansvarlige om prioriteringer, budgetter og timing. 

Du skal ikke kunne producere alt selv. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, følge op og sikre, at de rette mennesker har, hvad de skal bruge for at komme i mål. 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har en god forståelse for marketing, er naturligt struktureret og trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker mange ting.  

  • Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring fra en koordinatorrolle i en marketingafdeling, et digitalt bureau, reklamebureau eller lignende. 

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller tilsvarende. 

  • Har en god forståelse for digital marketing, herunder sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, annoncering og websites. 

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til projektstyringsværktøjer som Asana, Monday.com eller lignende. 

  • Har gode skriftlige kommunikationsevner og flair for kommercielt indhold. 

  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at følge op på opgaver og deadlines. 

  • Er proaktiv, har ben i næsen og tør stille spørgsmål og udfordre kolleger konstruktivt. 

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt, og flere opgaver skal løses samtidig. 

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen, arbejdet med marketing på tværs af flere lande eller kendskab til Klaviyo, CMS eller Canva, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav. 

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager initiativ og motiveres af at skabe struktur og gode resultater sammen med andre. 

Hvem er MyCruise? 

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse. 

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises og River cruises. 

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder marketing tæt sammen med blandt andet salg, produkt og e-commerce om at inspirere vores kunder og skabe gode rejseoplevelser. 

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og alsidig marketingrolle med mulighed for at gøre en forskel. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af vores fire markeder. 

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med marketing i en branche, hvor vi sælger oplevelser og rejser. 

  • Personalepriser på rejser. 

  • Pension og sundhedsordning. 

  • Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand. 

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

  • En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og plads til nye idéer. 

  • Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S-tog. 

Lyder det som dig? 

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 9 måneder med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Arbeidsleder - Stillas bransjen
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter en arbeidsleder som kan lede vårt team og sikre effektiv og sikker gjennomføring av prosjektene våre. Vi er en ledende aktør innen stillas bygging, og vi søker en dyktig arbeidende formann for å styrke vårt team i Møre og Romsdal. Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe på spennende prosjekter, samtidig som du leder et kompetent team.

Hva vi ser etter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ansvarsfull og selvstendig.

  • Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å motivere og veilede teammedlemmer.

  • Løsningsorientert og trygg i utfordrende situasjoner.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Lede og organisere stillasbygging på byggeplasser.

  • Sikre at prosjektene gjennomføres i henhold til sikkerhetskrav og forskrifter.

  • Koordinere arbeidsteamet og sørge for effektiv ressursbruk.

  • Utføre risikovurdering og sørge for sikkerheten på byggeplassen.

  • Kommunisere med prosjektledelse og kunder.

  • Delta aktivt i det praktiske stillasarbeidet.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Må ha godkjent sertifisering i stillasarbeid enten med fagbrev eller som godkjent stillasmontører etter § 17-4.

  • Minimum 5 års erfaring som arbeidende formann eller i relevant rolle.

  • Gode lederegenskaper og erfaring med teamledelse.

  • God forståelse for sikkerhet og risikovurdering.

  • Førerkort for bil (fordel med BE og CE) og gjerne truckførerbevis.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn.

  • Gode arbeidsforhold i et støttende arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.

  • Fast ansettelse med forsikringsordninger og pensjonsavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fjord Stillas As er et selskap som driver med utleie og montering av stillas, samt opplæring innenfor stillas faget. Fjord Stillas As henvender seg i all hovedsak mot proffmarkedet. Vi har hatt en stor del av vår virksomhet rettet mot privat og forskjellige industrier, hvor vi har stillas ansvar for prosjektledelse, montering og stillas utstyr. Vi har også mye aktivitet mot bygg og anleggsbransjen. Utleie parken består av fasade og spirstillas i aluminium, som vi monterer og leier ut over hele Møre og Romsdal. Fjord Stillas As har 8 egne montører og leier inn ekstra montører ved behov.

jobs.description: Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle henkilökohtaisen avun pariin? Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on hyvä asenne sekä sosiaaliset taidot.Etsimme Suonenjoen Kokkolammelle avustajaa 68-vuotiaalle miesasiakkaalle. Hän asuu yksin omakotitalossa ja liikkuu pyörätuolilla. Avustamisen tunteja on 50 kuukaudessa ja avustamisen päivät ovat maanantai, keskiviikko ja perjantai klo 9-13. Tärkeimpinä työtehtävinä ovat asioilla käynti (liikutaan asiakkaan autolla), kodin siivousaskareet ja kuntosalilla käynti. Asiakkaalla ei ole lemmikkejä ja kuntosaliharrastuksen lisäksi hän on myös innokas penkkiurheilija! Avustajan toivotaan olevan omatoiminen ja avoin, leipomainnokkuus on plussaa!**Me teemme työtä aina asiakkaan hyvinvointi edellä ja olemmekin siinä melkoisen hyviä: sisäpiirissä olevat sanoisivat, että pykälää parempia!****Lupaammekin sinulle:**\- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen\- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi\- lähiesihenkilön tuen\- monipuolisen työnkuvan\- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan\- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,33 € - 14,64 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen


Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.


Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. 

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.


We offer

  • A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here 

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. 


Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

  • You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around  you. 

  • You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.

  • You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.

  • You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.

  • You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.

  • You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.

  • You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.

jobs.title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen.

Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten.

  • Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen.

  • Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag.

  • Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt.

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert.

  • Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit.

  • Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan.

  • 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen.

  • Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

  • Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage.

  • De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt.

  • Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen.

  • Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool.

  • Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré.

  • Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen.

  • Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Follo?

Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact.

  • Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong.

  • AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows.

  • Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders.

  • Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities.

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
jobs.description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. 

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development


What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description: ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOONKotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.Nähdään Alinassa!----------------------------------------Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? jobs.title: Senior ERP Transformation Lead - IFS Cloud
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior ERP Transformation Lead to lead a large-scale business and ERP modernization initiative for a major Nordic enterprise.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

This is a high-impact leadership assignment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders and responsibility for driving a complex transformation from legacy IFS environments to IFS Cloud. The role goes far beyond traditional project management and requires someone who can effectively lead change, influence senior decisionmakers, and build alignment across both business and technology organizations.

Youll take ownership of a strategic transformation program covering several core business functions, including:
 Finance
 Human Resources
 Procurement & Supplier Management
 Enterprise-wide business processes and supporting platforms

The objective is not only to modernize the ERP landscape, but also to transform business processes, governance models, and ways of working across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities:
 Lead a complex ERP transformation program end-to-end
 Drive migration from legacy IFS to IFS Cloud
 Act as the bridge between business and technology teams
 Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level executives
 Establish governance, alignment, and decision-making across the organization
 Lead change management and business transformation activities

Requirements:
 Proven experience leading large-scale ERP transformation programs
Strong IFS / IFS Cloud transformation experience
 Background in business transformation and organizational change
 Experience working directly with executive stakeholders
 Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
 Experience in multinational and complex business environments

Ideal Profile:
You are a senior transformation leader who combines ERP expertise with strong executive presence and the ability to build alignment, challenge stakeholders, and drive change across business and IT functions.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you led an ERP transformation involving IFS or IFS Cloud?*
- Have you worked directly with CIO, CFO, or other C-level stakeholders?*
- Have you led business transformation alongside technology implementation?*
- Have you managed stakeholders across multiple countries or business units?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Start: ASAP
Location: Finland
Allocation: Full-time 100 %
Duration: 14-18 months initially, with potential extension
Languages: English required, Finnish preferred

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

jobs.title: Administrativ kontorelev med interesse for drift og kørselsdisponering
jobs.description:
Bliv godt kørende med en elevuddannelse hos HB-Care! Som kontorelev hos HB-Care bliver du en vigtig del af det daglige arbejde i vores driftsteam, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at levere kvalitet og god kundeservice. Du får en 2-årig elevuddannelse med speciale i administration, hvor du både kommer på skoleforløb og får masser af praktisk erfaring i virksomheden.

Undervejs bliver du introduceret til alle relevante områder, og du får også mulighed for at besøge vores andre afdelinger som fx bogholderi og udbud.

Vi tilbyder en alsidig uddannelse med praktisk erfaring, som giver dig et bredt kendskab til vores forskellige opgaver inden for driftsoptimering og administration.

Dine arbejdsopgaverHverdagen i vores driftsteam er præget af højt tempo. Vores vigtigste opgave er at supportere vores kunder – både borgere og institutioner – via mail og telefon.

Som elev vil du bl.a. arbejde med:

  • Indtastning og vedligeholdelse af stamdata
  • Oprettelse i kundesystemer
  • Administrative opgaver, der understøtter effektiv kørsel
  • Daglig support til drift og disponering
  • Håndtering af uforudsete hændelser i løbet af arbejdsdagen

Du får en spændende rolle, hvor du deltager aktivt i den daglige drift og gradvist får mere ansvar. Du refererer til regionschefen for Sjælland og Fyn.

Hvem er du?Vi søger dig, som har:

  • En naturlig interesse for processer
  • En struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til opgaver
  • Gode IT-kompetencer, især i Office-pakken
  • Øje for detaljer og lyst til at levere grundige resultater
  • Evne til at håndtere en varieret hverdag, hvor du kan blive afbrudt midt i en opgave
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

Uddannelseskrav:Du har bestået – eller forventer at bestå – en af følgende:

  • EUX Business (kontor)
  • HHX
  • HF, HTX eller STX samt 5 ugers EUS-forløb 

Er du over 25 år?Så skal du kontakte din lokale handelsskole for at få lavet en realkompetencevurdering (RKV), som skal vedhæftes din ansøgning.

OBS: Husk, at du ikke må oplyse dit CPR-nummer i din ansøgning eller dit CV.

Ansættelsesdato:Ønsket opstart mellem d. 1. januar og 1. marts 2027 – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Hvem er vi?HB-Care er Danmarks førende leverandør af visiteret specialkørsel til kommuner og institutioner. Vi sørger hver dag for, at ældre borgere kommer til genoptræning, at skolebørn bliver kørt til undervisning, og at personer med særlige behov kommer sikkert frem til deres destinationer. Vores arbejde kræver både præcision, struktur og stor omtanke – og det er netop her, du kan blive en vigtig del af vores team.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at fremstille avanceret måleudstyr, der anvendes til måling af vakuumtryk i højteknologiske produktionsprocesser?

  • Loddearbejde (både SMT og through-hole)

  • Test og kalibrering af transducere

  • Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation

Hos Sens4 bliver du en del af et mindre team, der samler, tester og konfigurerer tryk- og vakuumtransducere. Derudover vil du også indgå i opgaver omkring kvalitetskontrol ved varemodtagelse.

  • Har erfaring med lodning og arbejde med små komponenter

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde

  • Er en teamplayer, der trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor fleksibilitet

Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig hverdag med varierende opgaver, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med en flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og god balance mellem arbejde og fritid

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi evaluerer ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen lukkes, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, og kan derfor blive besat inden ansøgningsfristen.

jobs.title: Vi søger rengøringshelte på 35 timer til Børnehave Solsikken med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af Team Rent Guld – vi hjemtager rengøringen i hele kommunen Team Rent Guld er Guldborgsund Kommunes samlede rengøringsenhed, som fra 1. januar 2027 får ansvaret for rengøringen på tværs af hele kommunen. Vi er i gang med at opbygge en professionel og velfungerende organisation, hvor kvalitet, stabil drift og godt samarbejde er i centrum.

Vi leder efter engagerede rengøringshelte, som vil være med til at skabe rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for kommunens borgere og medarbejdere. Den gyldne mission er at indeklimaet er en ren fornøjelse at befinde sig i.

Om Team Rent Guld Afdelingen bliver en stor og vigtig del af kommunens daglige drift og vil bestå af 2 afdelingsledere, 3 fagkoordinatorer, 3 flyvere og ca. 90 rengøringsassistenter. Sammen sikrer vi rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for både borgere, brugere og medarbejdere.

Hos os er rengøring en faglig opgave, der gør en reel forskel. Vi arbejder systematisk med kvalitet, moderne metoder og gode arbejdsgange – og vi prioriterer, at alle medarbejdere er godt klædt på til opgaven.

Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på fællesskab og fleksibilitet. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af lokationer ved fravær, spidsbelastninger og hovedrengøring, og vi tror på, at en god arbejdsdag skabes gennem samarbejde, ansvar og en positiv tilgang.

Team Rent Guld er derfor ikke bare en arbejdsplads – det er et fællesskab, hvor du bliver en del af noget større og er med til at sætte standarden for fremtidens kommunale rengøring.

Om stillingen

· 1 medarbejdere på 35 timer ugentligt

· Mødetid kl. 05:00

· Mulighed for flere timer ved fravær, travlhed og hovedrengøring

· Mulighed for helligdagsarbejde

· Synlig rengøring af kommunale bygninger

· Sikring af et godt indeklima for brugere og borgere

· Samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af lokationer

Arbejdssteder kan være

· Skoler

· Daginstitutioner

· Plejecentre

· Sportshaller

· Administrative bygninger

· Offentlige faciliteter

Hvem er du?

· En sprudlende personlighed, der ikke er bange for at tackle smuds, snavs og andre udfordringer med et smil - du synes rengøring er sjovt  

· Du kan jonglere med dine opgaver 

· Du er organiseret og pålidelig 

· Du har sans for humor og evne til at skabe et positivt og sjovt miljø omkring dig og din rengøringsopgave  

· Du skal have gode kommunikationsevner og øje for detaljen

· Du kan tale, læse og forstå dansk

Tidligere erfaring og uddannelse som rengøringsassistent eller rengøringsteknikker kan være en bonus, men ikke et krav. Vi træner gerne den rette person til at opnå skinnende resultater  

Vi tilbyder

· Et sjovt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø fyldt med humor og kollegial støtte 

· Mulighed for at være med til at forme Rent Guld og din egen hverdag 

· Gode personlige- og faglige udviklingsmuligheder

· Du bliver klædt godt på til at løfte rengøringsopgaven og vi holder dig opdateret på de nyeste rengøringsmetoder og teknikker

Ansættelsesvilkår· Stillingerne er til besættelse senest den 1. januar 2027

· Efter gældende overenskomst med 3F 

· Kørekort (kategori B) er en fordel, men ikke et krav

· Ansættelse sker med forbehold for godkendt børne- og/eller straffeattest

Ansøgning Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på ”send ansøgning” og vedhæft din ansøgning, dit CV samt et billede senest den 15. november 2026. Vi tager kun imod elektroniske ansøgninger.

Samtaler afholdes i 25. november 2026 på Rådhuset. 

Mere information Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Michell Andresen, afdelingsleder for Rent Guld Syd på tlf. 25 18 06 52 eller på mail mdja@guldborgsund.dk

Mere om Guldborgsund Kommune Guldborgsund Kommune har pr. 1. august 2015 indført røgfri arbejdstid. Læs mere om Guldborgsund Kommune på www.guldborgsund.dk

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af Rent Guld og tilføre ekstra glans til vores kommune, så send os din ansøgning i dag.

jobs.title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. 

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 11th November 2026   

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.
