jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

jobs.title: Medhjælper i bageriet - Priorparken
jobs.description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Medhjælper til bageriet, der kan hjælpe os med at holde produktionen godt kørende og skabe friskbagt brød, kager og bagværk til vores gæster hver dag. Her bruger du din lyst til at lære, dit gode drive og din glæde ved at arbejde sammen med andre, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…Kort sagt handler rollen om at understøtte produktionen og lære arbejdet i bageriet godt at kende.

Den lidt længere version er, at du bliver en del af et team, hvor du får oplæring i de forskellige opgaver i produktionen. Det kan være alt fra dejhåndtering, bagning og pakning til brug af maskiner og opsætning af frost. Hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver, og vi roterer, så vi kan hjælpe hinanden. Du bliver en del af vores centralbageri, hvor bageri, pakkeri og logistik arbejder tæt sammen, og hvor vi hver dag skaber friskbagt kvalitet til vores gæster.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • har lyst til at arbejde med bageri og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dig i rollen

  • er en holdspiller og bidrager til den gode stemning

  • gerne har erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, men det er ikke et krav

  • kan tale, læse og forstå dansk eller engelsk

Hvad vi tilbyder digVi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos osDin arbejdsuge er på 37 timer, hvor du arbejder med fast natarbejdstid mellem kl. 18.00 og 04.00 (arbejdstiden kan skifte) og fri hver anden weekend.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

  • Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

  • Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

  • Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

  • Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

  • Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

  • Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

  • Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

  • Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Power Platform Advisor - AI & Solution Architecture
jobs.description: **We are looking for an experienced professional who wants to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, useful solutions—and help customers make the right choices along the way. This role brings together business insight, solution architecture and hands-on development. You will help customers discover what is worth building, shape the solution, and stay involved in making it real.****About the role**You will work closely with customers to understand their challenges, processes and constraints—and uncover the real need behind the initial request. You will turn those discussions into viable opportunities, sound architectural choices and an actionable delivery plan. Depending on the assignment, you may take the work from discovery and solution shaping through implementation, deployment and further development.This is not a role for a purely high-level architect. We are looking for someone who can design the bigger picture, document the decisions that matter, and still build or validate key parts of the solution.Our home ground is Microsoft Power Platform and the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem. Depending on the assignment, your toolkit may include Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, API Management, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub and GitHub Copilot.**What you could be working on**The exact mix will depend on the customer and assignment, but your work could include:- Leading stakeholder discussions to uncover the real business need and decide what is worth building. - Turning requirements into scalable solution architectures, data models, integration designs and practical delivery plans. - Designing and delivering intelligent applications, agents and automation with Power Platform, Azure and related services. - Creating clear architecture diagrams, technical notes and decision records that make assumptions, constraints and trade-offs visible. - Building and validating key parts of the solution yourself, while giving concrete technical guidance to the wider delivery team. - Helping customers make informed choices about feasibility, security, maintainability, lifecycle and good engineering practices. **Your background could look like this**You might currently describe yourself as a solution architect, application architect, technical consultant or senior developer. Perhaps you are a Power Platform professional who has worked with complex integrations, Azure services, and enterprise application architecture. Or you may come from pro-code software development and have moved towards architecture and consulting. There is more than one route into this role.What matters most is your ability to combine three perspectives:1\. **Technology:** You understand how modern applications are designed and built. You can discuss architecture, integrations, APIs, data, identity and security, and you are comfortable going into technical detail.2\. **Business:** You can uncover the actual need behind a request, ask the right questions, and help the customer decide what is worth building.3\. **Delivery:** You can turn plans, experiments and architectural choices into working, maintainable solutions.You do not need to arrive knowing every technology. However, you do need enough technical depth to make informed decisions independently, recognize risks and learn unfamiliar technologies without waiting for a predefined path.Above all, we value curiosity, sound judgement and a continuous learning mindset.**What we are looking for:**Titles matter less than what you can do. We are looking for someone who:- Enjoys solving business problems with technology - Can design the bigger picture without losing touch with implementation - Is excited about AI and modern Microsoft technologies & has experience working with both areas - Feels comfortable discussing architecture with developers and business stakeholders alike - Has experience delivering customer-facing projects and building trusted relationships - Wants to keep learning and sharing knowledge with others - Has fluent communication and presentation skills in Finnish and English Above all, we highly appreciate applicants with a continuous learning mindset.You will be part of our experienced Power Platform masterminds. On average, your colleagues have 5–20 years of relevant experience each, so you'll get to be part of an experienced group of experts.\*\*\***What to expect from the recruitment process**- Application period 27.10.–29.11.2026 - First meeting with Päivikki, team lead, and Poola, People & Culture - Second, more technical meeting with potential future colleagues - Preferred starting date according to agreement, in the beginning of 2027 Any changes to the process will be communicated to the applicants.**What we offer**- A central role where you can make an impact! - A great work home for professionals – our eNPS is 82! - A caring employer where we focus on impact and thriving together – who also supports continuous learning - Supportive, balanced and collaborative work environment & a culture which is built on trust - Flexible working hours and location (unlimited remote work according to company policy); https://careers.forwardforever.com/posts/remote-hybrid-or-office-honestly-we-don-t-label-it - Comprehensive company benefits including an additional health insurance Expected compensation will be within the range of 5000-6500 €/month.We are looking forward to hearing from you! Please send your resume and application letter at the latest on 29.11.2026 through our job ad. We will not just wait for the application period to hit its deadline, and neither should you! We will go through the applications already during the application period and fill the position as soon as we find the right person.If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to reach out to Poola, poola.isomaki@forwardforever.com. Please note that we use emails as part of our communication so double check that you have added an email address that you follow regularly.**Let's change the game, together!**

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Kokemäelle
jobs.description: **Haemme ammattisiivoojaa avustamaan asiakastamme Kokemäellä.****Mitä siivooja-helpperi tekee?** Siivooja-helpperi on henkilö, joka tukee asiakkaitamme ammatillisessa kotisiivouksessa. Asiakkaamme saa aina oman helpperinsä avukseen. Työ on mielekästä, sillä helpperinä pääset myös tutustumaan asiakkaaseen.Hemby tarjoaa kotisiivouksia tekeville helppereillemme laadukkaat siivousvälineet mikrokuituliinoista pesuaineisiin. Kotisiivouskäynneillä hyödynnämme asiakkaan imuria ja moppia lattioiden siistimiseen.**Mitä työ vaatii?** Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta. Lisäksi asiakaspalveluhenkisyys sekä reipas ote ovat työssä tarvittavia ominasuuksia. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat. Edellytämme työntekijöiltämme 18-vuoden ikää.**Mikä on Hemby?**Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:_"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."__"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."__Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan._**Siivooja-helpperinä saat:**- **Omat nimetyt asiakkaat**, joita autat kotisiivouksessa. - **Joustavat työajat,** jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa 2-6 tunnin ajan, riippuen asiakkaan asunnon koosta. - **Kilpailukykyisen palkan:** Tuntipalkka 13,20-15,98 €/h + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. - **Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet:** Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän työpanoksesi ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! - **Monipuolisen työn:** siivoojana voit halutessasi myös olla avuksi asiakkaillemme arjen muissa askareissa. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä:**https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi**Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen. Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää siivooja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Pattern Design Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pattern design and motivated by bringing out the best in others? Do you enjoy taking the lead, driving projects forward and finding better ways of working, without losing touch with the craft you love?

Whether you're an experienced manager or looking to take your first step into leadership, at SELECTED you'll have the opportunity to lead a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants across menswear and womenswear while staying hands-on with pattern development.

YOUR TEAMYou'll become part of SELECTED's creative environment, where pattern design plays an important role in bringing our collections to life.Working closely with colleagues in Design and Buying, you and your team will turn design ideas into well-constructed garments, finding the right balance between creative intentions, fit, quality and commercial considerations.With responsibilities spanning both menswear and womenswear, you'll work with different perspectives and priorities, helping create a shared approach and strong collaboration across the two areas.

YOUR ROLEYou'll take responsibility for the team's performance and development while continuing to work hands-on with pattern development within your own product category.Beyond the day-to-day leadership, you'll drive projects, bring structure to shared priorities and help develop the technical standards and processes behind our collections. Your experience will be important in guiding decisions, solving technical challenges and ensuring progress across menswear and womenswear.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants, supporting their individual growth and performance.

  • Taking hands-on responsibility for pattern development within your own product category, including fittings and technical adjustments.

  • Driving projects and coordinating priorities across menswear and womenswear.

  • Developing pattern design processes and technical standards to improve fit, construction and consistency.

  • Working closely with Design and Buying to find solutions that meet both creative and commercial needs.

  • Exploring and implementing digital pattern-making and 3D development tools where they can improve our work.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll be part of an international fashion business with high ambitions and a genuine interest in doing things better. We work across disciplines, challenge each other's thinking and believe that good ideas can come from anywhere. It's an environment where you're encouraged to contribute your perspective and make your experience count.We also recognise that doing great work doesn't mean working the same way every day. You'll have flexibility in planning your work and the opportunity to work from home when your responsibilities allow it, balancing time with your colleagues and the freedom to organise your own day.

YOUR PROFILEYou know your craft and enjoy using your experience to make others better. You're comfortable taking responsibility, bringing structure to projects and making decisions, even when different perspectives and priorities need to be considered.For us, your ability and motivation to lead matter more than whether you've held a management title before. You might already have experience managing a team, or you might be an experienced specialist ready to take on your first formal leadership role. What matters is that you can provide clear direction, involve others and create an environment where people can develop and deliver strong results together.

We imagine that you bring:

  • Solid experience in pattern design and garment construction within the fashion industry, including a strong understanding of fit, silhouettes and technical garment development.

  • The ability to plan, coordinate and drive projects involving different stakeholders.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to navigate different perspectives and priorities.

  • A structured approach to your work and an interest in improving existing methods.

  • An interest in digital pattern-making and 3D garment development.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Manja Ann Jacobsen on + 45 52 15 37 30. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 26 November 2026.  We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad, when we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Experienced forklift driver for cold storage production
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working at -20°C and have strong forklift skills?

We are currently looking for an experienced and reliable forklift driver to drive the forklift in a cold storage production, handling fresh and frozen poultry products.

You will be working in a storage facility with temperatures around -20°C, and it is important that you are comfortable working in a cold environment throughout your shift. We are looking for someone who thrives in these conditions and understands the importance of maintaining both safety and efficiency while working in cold temperatures.

The warehouse has narrow aisles and limited operating space, making forklift experience essential. Precision, awareness, and safe operation are critical to success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Receiving fresh poultry products from production

  • Transporting fresh products into the freezer for freezing

  • Moving frozen products throughout the warehouse using a forklift

  • Preparing products for shipment and distribution

  • Handling shipping documents, labels, and product identification

  • Ensuring correct traceability and documentation

  • Maintaining order and cleanliness throughout the freezer warehouse

  • Assisting with daily warehouse and logistics operations

  • Following all food safety, quality, and safety procedures

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Holds a valid forklift certificate/license

  • Has solid forklift driving experience from warehouse, logistics, or production companies.

  • Is comfortable working in temperatures of approximately -20°C

  • Thrives in a cold working environment and can maintain a high level of performance throughout the day

  • Has experience operating forklifts in narrow aisles and confined spaces

  • Understands the importance of safe and accurate forklift operation

  • Works independently and takes responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Is structured, quality-conscious, and reliable

  • Has experience working with shipping documents, labels, and warehouse procedures

  • Takes pride in keeping the warehouse organized and efficient

Working Hours

  • Monday to Thursday: Start at 08:35 AM and work until all scheduled tasks are completed

  • Every 6th & 7th Friday: Start at 08:35 AM

  • 37 hours a week, overtime should be expected.

We Offer

  • A stable full-time position in a growing company

  • Long-term employment opportunities

  • A professional and supportive working environment

  • An important role within the warehouse and logistics operation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

  • Immediate start for the right candidate

Location: Horsens, orsensDenmarkStart Date: As soon as possibleEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: Based on qualifications and experience

Apply Today

If you are an experienced forklift driver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and can thrive in a -20°C freezer, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today, remember to upload your CV. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job within fish production and enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced and professional production environment? Do you have experience from the fish or food industry and take pride in delivering high-quality work? If so, we would like to hear from you.

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

  • Sorting, processing, and preparing fish products

  • Filleting, trimming, and cutting fish

  • Quality control and inspection of products

  • Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

  • Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

  • Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

  • Have previous experience from fish production, food production, or a similar manufacturing environment

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high level of quality

  • Are able to follow strict hygiene, safety, and quality procedures

  • Are reliable, punctual, and have a positive attitude towards teamwork

 

What We Offer

  • A good and supportive working environment with colleagues from many different nationalities

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Workwear and safety footwear provided by the company

  • Access to a canteen with the option to purchase food

  • The opportunity to gain valuable experience within a professional food production company

Salary: 143,40,- + 6,50,- per hour.

Important Information

Due to the location of the workplace and the early working hours, public transportation is not a realistic option, and it is therefore necessary that you have your own reliable means of transportation to and from work.

Due to strict hygiene and food safety requirements, jewelry, piercings, artificial nails, and artificial eyelashes are not permitted in the production area.

If you are looking for long-term employment in a professional production environment and have experience from the fish or food industry, we encourage you to apply. We are looking for employees who are ready to contribute, work as part of a team, and help maintain the high standards our customer is known for.

Interested? We conduct ongoing interviews and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description: Née de la fusion de deux unités opérationnelles, la société GABBANAelcom S.A. réunit plus de  collaborateurs spécialisés dans tous les domaines de l'équipement technique du bâtiment : chauffage, sanitaire, ventilation, climatisation, électricité, domotique, énergies renouvelables, et bien plus encore. Vos missions :  -        Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des installations sanitaires.-        Diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements et identifier l'origine des pannes et des fuites d'eau puis réaliser les réparations afin d'assurer le bon fonctionnement des installations.-        Effectuer des permanences.-        Assurer le dépannage des réseaux d'eau, des robinetteries, des équipements sanitaires et des canalisations ainsi que la détection, le diagnostic et la réparation des fuites d'eau.-        Contrôler le bon fonctionnement des installations et veiller à leur conformité.-        Effectuer les opérations d'entretien et de remise en état des installations.-        Assurer le suivi des interventions et rédiger les rapports techniques nécessaires.-        Conseiller les clients sur l'utilisation et l'entretien de leurs équipements.-        Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité, des normes en vigueur et des procédures de l'entreprise. jobs.title: Head of Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit lets anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, and websites that solve real problems.

We are looking for a Head of Corporate Affairs - Strategy & Growth to help lead Replit’s next chapter of enterprise expansion, strategic relationship building, and institutional engagement.

This is a senior, commercially minded role for a strategic, hands-on leader who can turn relationships across government and industry into real opportunities for Replit. As Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI and enterprise transformation, you will build the relationships and pathways that accelerate adoption across the public and private sectors.

The role sits at the intersection of corporate affairs, business development, public sector strategy, and enterprise growth. It is not a traditional government relations role focused on policy, access, or reputation. You will build a repeatable, measurable approach to turning senior-level engagement into qualified pipeline, adoption, and long-term value, working closely with the President of Public Sector and Corporate Affairs, the executive team, and sales and go-to-market leaders.

 


ROLE

 - Lead the growth strategy for Corporate Affairs, turning senior-level relationships across government and industry into revenue opportunities and pipeline.

 - Identify target accounts across government and industry, and prioritize building C-suite relationships that accelerate enterprise adoption.

 - Partner with business development, sales, and go-to-market leaders to align outreach, create pathways into target organizations, and convert executive engagement into qualified opportunities.

 - Develop repeatable playbooks for executive engagement and institutional partnerships, establishing a scalable relationship-to-revenue motion.

 - Build the operating cadence, metrics, and reporting to measure Corporate Affairs’ contribution to pipeline development, enterprise growth, and adoption.

 - Represent Replit in senior-level meetings, industry forums, and government engagements to strengthen strategic relationships and advance business opportunities.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 10+ years of experience in corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, business development, public sector strategy, enterprise sales, government relations, government, or related fields.

 - Experience building or significantly expanding a relationship-driven growth, partnerships, or business development function at a fast-growing technology company or similarly complex organization.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise and public sector go-to-market motions, including how procurement, stakeholder alignment, and internal champions influence adoption.

 - Strong executive presence and communication skills, with credibility among C-suite leaders, government officials, and technical stakeholders.

 - Ability to translate complex technical products and AI capabilities into clear business value.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset, with the ability to build new programs without an established playbook.

 - Passion for Replit’s mission and for AI-powered software creation expanding who can build software.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
GEV Wind Power is seeking experienced Competent Wind Turbine Technicians to join our offshore operations team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on Vestas offshore wind turbines, delivering high-quality maintenance and troubleshooting support whilst contributing to the safe and efficient operation of critical renewable energy assets.

We have roles commencing from January 2027 and will operate on a 4-week rotational schedule.

As a Competent Technician, you will carry out planned and corrective maintenance activities offshore while supporting fault-finding and troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems. Â· Work collaboratively with offshore maintenance teams to maximise turbine availability and production.

Â· Support Authorised Technicians and site leadership teams in delivering operational objectives.

Â· Participate in daily toolbox talks, pre-job briefings, risk assessments, and lift planning activities.

Â· Contribute positively to team performance and foster a professional, safety-focused working environment.


Desirable Experience:

jobs.title: Country Manager Canada
jobs.description:
Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

The Role

As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders.

  • National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint.

  • Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth.

  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams.

  • Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct.

  • Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance.

  • Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential.

  • Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains.

  • Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders.

  • Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision.

  • Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy.

AI in our hiring process

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

Â 

Our Approach to AI

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.
