jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

 

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker

  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation in High-Voltage Environments - 4391
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for an Assistant Professor position in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation for Drones and Robots in High-Voltage Environments. The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Applicants must document the following qualifications and experience:

  • A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

  • Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

  • Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

  • Experience in university teaching, course development, and supervision of engineering students, together with pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position.

  • A proven ability to attract external research funding as principal investigator or key contributor.

  • A strong publication record in leading international journals and conferences, including publications resulting from international collaborations.

  • Demonstrated experience in international research projects and collaborative activities with academic and industrial partners.

  • Experience serving as reviewer for leading international journals and conferences in relevant research fields.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage.

 

Workplace description

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark conducts research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications, using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies. The section develops next-generation electronics and computing solutions to address technological challenges in autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare.

The section contributes to the electrical engineering programmes in Odense, including Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Over the next few years, the section is expected to expand to at least 30 staff members, including academic staff, PhD students, and engineers, supporting research, industrial collaboration, and education. This growth will strengthen the section’s contribution to electrical engineering and related fields.

SDU’s Odense campus comprises six faculties, providing opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich environment, a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre.

Further Information

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Curriculum Vitae, including contact information, research experience, relevant projects, technical skills, and teaching and supervision experience.

  • Research plan outlining the proposed research agenda, its alignment with the position and the section’s activities, and plans for developing a research line and research team.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching qualifications, pedagogical experience, course development, and student supervision. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three referees who can provide an informed reference at short notice. Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics in Odense at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a PhD position in energy harvesting for bio-inspired flying robots. The position focuses on developing energy-harvesting techniques that use the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines to support autonomous inspection of power lines. The starting date is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  

This is a three-year PhD position based at SDU’s campus in Odense, Denmark.

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

The section contributes to our educational programmes in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Its activities span research, industrial collaboration, and education in electrical engineering and related areas.

The SDU campus in Odense comprises six faculties, bringing together academics and students in an environment that supports interdisciplinary research and a rich student life. Odense offers a vibrant robotics community, cultural activities, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river that runs through the city centre.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join the FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a bird-like flying robot for autonomous inspection of power lines. The PhD research will focus on energy harvesting to enable self-sustaining operation of this bio-inspired robotic platform.

Research Focus – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots

You will investigate, analyse, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable bio-inspired aerial robots to draw energy from the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines. Your research will contribute to the development of self-sustaining flying robotic systems, with the aim of enabling extended autonomous inspection missions.

General Responsibilities

As a PhD student on this project, you will:

  • Conduct research on energy harvesting from the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines, contributing to the development of a self-sustaining, bird-like autonomous flying robot for inspection of power lines.

  • Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas.

  • Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-driven candidate with a strong interest in energy harvesting and its application to bio-inspired flying robots. If you are motivated to contribute to innovative research in autonomous inspection of power lines, we encourage you to apply.

 

Required Qualifications

  • A completed BSc and MSc in electronics, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply, provided they complete their MSc before the starting date and meet the applicable PhD admission requirements.

  • Strong technical skills relevant to energy harvesting, particularly magnetic-field energy harvesting, electronics, and embedded hardware architectures.

  • Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications.

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.)

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

  • Holde orden og sikre god hygiejne i opvaskeområdet

  • Hjælpe med rengøring og lettere praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

  • Sørge for, at rent udstyr er klar, når kollegerne har brug for det

  • Samarbejde tæt med køkkenet og resten af hotellets team

  • Arbejder effektivt og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt

  • Har sans for orden, renlighed og hygiejne

  • Er en god kollega og hjælper, hvor der er behov

  • Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab

  • Kan arbejde på skiftende tidspunkter, herunder aftener og weekender

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads på et ikonisk hotel med historie, sjæl og høje ambitioner

  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

  • En kultur præget af stolthed, nærvær og ordentlighed

  • Grundig oplæring og mulighed for udvikling

  • En varieret hverdag i særlige omgivelser

  • Mulighed for personalebolig

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ruths-hotel.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jack Cramer på samme e-mailadresse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

  • Assisting with cleaning and other practical tasks in the kitchen

  • Works efficiently and stays organised during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on cleanliness, order and hygiene

  • Is a supportive colleague who is willing to help where needed

  • Has a positive attitude and enjoys being part of a team

  • Is available for flexible working hours, including evenings and weekends

We offer

  • A workplace at an iconic hotel with history, character and high ambitions

  • A strong team culture in which colleagues support one another

Please send your application and CV to job@ruths-hotel.dk.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jack Cramer at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Ejendomsfunktionær med erfaring inden for grøn vedligeholdelse til Møllevænget & Storgaarden
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med grøn vedligeholdelse, og trives du med en arbejdsdag under åben himmel?

Hos Boligorganisationen Møllevænget & Storgaarden søger vi en ejendomsfunktionær, der har praktisk erfaring med pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder, og som er vant til at arbejde udendørs året rundt.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift af vores boligområder, hvor du er med til at sikre velholdte udearealer og gode rammer for beboerne.

Vi søger dig, der har styr på de grønne opgaver, arbejder selvstændigt og sætter pris på en hverdag, hvor du kan se resultatet af dit arbejde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som ejendomsfunktionær får du din daglige gang i vores boligområder med frihed under ansvar og en varieret arbejdsdag.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder, herunder græsslåning, hækklipning, beskæring og pasning af bede.

  • Vedligeholdelse af stier, parkeringspladser, legepladser og øvrige fællesarealer.

  • Mindre reparationer og forskellige praktiske opgaver i boligområderne.

  • Snerydning og saltning i vinterperioden.

  • Daglig kontakt og dialog med beboerne i vores boligområder.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en kollega, der har erfaring med pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder. Det kan eksempelvis være fra anlægsgartnerbranchen, grøn ejendomsservice eller lignende arbejde.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og se, hvilke opgaver der skal løses.

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde udendørs - også når vejret ikke viser sig fra sin bedste side.

jobs.title: Mechanic, HGV Mechanic or Welder wanted for varied role in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

Your Qualifications

We imagine that you:

  • Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

  • Have several years of experience from a similar position

  • Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

  • Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

  • Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Work in a structured and independent manner

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible

  • Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

The position is available as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right candidate.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Dan Andersen on +45 28 45 80 35.

Are you ready for your next step? Submit your application via this link: https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=1035&ProjectId=146126&DepartmentId=18964&MediaId=5

We look forward to hearing from you!

What We Do

We partner with employers to provide a complete approach to pet and pet-parent wellbeing, from preventive wellness plans and emergency coverage to 24/7 pet telehealth guidance. jobs.title: Enablement Program Manager, Japan and Korea
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Join us on our mission to help everyone shape the tools that shape their lives.

At Notion, we believe in building software that adapts to how people work, not the other way around. As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships.

We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to own the development and implementation of global enablement programs that scale seamlessly across regions. You'll spend 50% of your time developing and locally implementing these global programs, and 50% tuning enablement initiatives to meet regional needs—all while maintaining a globally aligned selling process that honors local market nuances.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone who can think globally while acting locally. You'll leverage AI and automation to build scalable enablement solutions that empower our revenue teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences worldwide.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

Global Program Development & Implementation (50%)

 - Champion our global operating cadence to ensure the Japan and Korea region is successfully executing our GTM strategy as an extension of the Global Revenue Operations team

 - Design, develop and manage comprehensive enablement programs that can be deployed globally while maintaining consistency in our selling methodology and GTM goals

 - Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales Leadership, and Product Marketing to create scalable training curriculum, design content, program manage SME stakeholders, develop certification programs, deploy continuous training frameworks frameworks and more

 - Build and maintain our global sales playbook, ensuring it reflects best practices that work across diverse markets

 - Leverage AI tools and automation to create personalized learning paths, real-time coaching recommendations for revenue team members and leverage the work of our Enablement team

 - Establish measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and ROI across all regions — you'll close the loop and report out on progress

 - Lead cross-functional initiatives to align product releases, go-to-market strategies, and enablement rollouts

Regional Tuning & Localization (50%)

 - Collaborate with regional sales and GTM leaders to identify local market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer behavior patterns

 - Adapt global programs to address regional needs while maintaining core methodology and brand consistency

 - Create region-specific content, case studies, and competitive battle cards that resonate with local markets

 - Build feedback loops between regional teams and global program development to continuously improve our approach

 - Support regional team leads in coaching and reinforcing enablement initiatives within their teams




ABOUT YOU

Experience & Expertise

 - 7-10+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar go-to-market roles

 - Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple geographies

 - Expert in adult learning methodologies and creating compelling multimodal content

 - High proficiency with the enablement tool stack including emerging AI and automation solutions (ideally AI is already embedded into your workflow)

 - Experience working with global sales teams and understanding of diverse market dynamics

 - Strong analytical skills with experience measuring program impact and ROI

Skills & Qualities

 - Strategic thinker who can balance global consistency with local relevance

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable working with senior leadership

 - Natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments

 - Data-driven approach to decision making with strong attention to detail

 - Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment

 - Passionate about developing people and helping teams reach their potential

 - Fluency in Japanese and English

Technical Requirements

 - Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), learning management systems, and sales enablement platforms

 - Proficiency with AI tools for content creation, data analysis, and process automation

 - Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously

 - Comfortable with sales analytics and performance metrics




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Background in sales, customer success, or revenue-generating roles

 - International work experience or familiarity with diverse cultural business practices

 - Experience with Notion or similar productivity tools

 - Certification in sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, etc.)

 - Fluency in Korean
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Field Phlebotomy Supervisor Northern California
jobs.description:
Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.

 

Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patientsâ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.

 

Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabsâ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.


About the role: 

We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible.

 

The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists.  Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly.

 

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. 

 

 

 

 

\n


At Getlabs, you will:
  • Supervise a team of mobile phlebotomists in one or more geographical markets
  • Assess work performance and perform appointment reviews for compliance, quality, and safety on a regular basis; accurately report all findings
  • Administer disciplinary action as appropriate
  • Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists
  • Effectively and efficiently onboard new hires
  • Complete new hire and annual competency assessments for team
  • Ensure accurate order and patient appointment record-keeping 
  • Administer performance reviewsHandle employee concerns and grievances
  • Review daily/weekly schedules for team and make schedule adjustments as needed; organize, plan, and assign work
  • Plan and manage a budget
  • Assist with day-to-day customer service and manager-level escalations including interactions with patients via inbound calls, outbound calls, emails, and other communication platforms
  • Review and approve team timecards and expenses 


What we are looking for:
  • At least 2 years of management experience in a leadership position is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT) In-depth knowledge of phlebotomy duties, responsibilities and techniques a plus!
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills; both written and verbal (Google suite a plus)
  • A disciplined worker who can work independently or in a team environment
  • Reliable transportation and clean driving record
  • Competency with Google applications and willingness to embrace new technology
  • A proven ability to handle ambiguity in the absence of defined systems and processes


We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:
  • Competitive annual salary ranging $95,000-$105,000
  • Valuable stock option plan
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Flexible and unlimited vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!


\n

The health and safety of our employees and their families is our top priority. Due to the ongoing nature of the COVID-19 pandemic we have decided to require vaccination as a condition of employment for any employee who is in contact with patients.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
jobs.description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional.

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an engineer who rapidly turns promising image- and video-generation techniques into evaluated, shipped MyArchitectAI features. This is hands-on product building: not pure research, and not a pure inference/infrastructure job. - In your first 30 days you ship a meaningful improvement, scoped with a founder: a new AI capability, a quality or speed gain, an evaluation system, or automation of manual work. You back it with visual examples and numbers. - By 60 days you find an opportunity yourself (new models, user data, weak spots in our pipeline), propose it and ship it. - By 90 days you have three or more shipped contributions and own the loop: find → evaluate → build → validate → ship → learn. - You keep a clear view of new models, techniques and competitors without chasing novelty for its own sake.

We offer: - Working directly with the founders, with real impact on the product.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Salary negotiable.

Other requirements: You have:- Hands-on work with generative image or video models (not only LLMs, RAG or agents). - At least one shipped product, deployed feature, meaningful open-source contribution, or convincing end-to-end project, and you can say exactly what you built. - Experience running experiments and making quality vs. speed vs. cost decisions. - The engineering skills to take a notebook or demo into a real product (Python, production-quality code). - Good written English (our working language). Estonian is not required. Nice to have: Diffusers, ComfyUI, ControlNet-style conditioning, inpainting and editing, LoRA and fine-tuning, video models, upscaling; your own evaluation datasets or benchmarks; GPU deployment and optimisation; 3D, AEC, CAD, rendering or interiors; public code, demos, models or write-ups.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
jobs.description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an early-career engineer who is already building things with generative image or video models on their own initiative. We care more about how fast you're improving than about your CV, and we want someone to grow with us for the long term. - In your first month you learn the product, the model pipelines and the quality bar, and ship a small but real improvement with a founder: a workflow, an evaluation script, a fix for a failing case, or an automation that removes manual work. - By three months you own a recurring piece of work end to end, such as maintaining an evaluation set, triaging generation failures, or keeping a model pipeline current. You ship several contributions, at least one you proposed yourself. - You read the research and release notes, try things, measure them, and report what they're worth. - After 6–12 months you take on features with just a goal and a deadline.

We offer: - Daily mentoring from the founders and real tasks from week one.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Room to grow with us for years. - Salary about €3,000 net per month (approx. €3,700–3,900 gross).

Other requirements: You have: - Public things you built yourself with image or video models: code, LoRAs, ComfyUI workflows, small apps or documented experiments. - Meaningful work in the last six months, with a trail going back at least a few months. - You're early in your career: student, self-taught, bootcamp, first or second job, or changing careers. - You can explain what you built, why it failed the first time, and how you knew it improved. - Written English good enough to work with two founders every day (our working language). Estonian is not required. Big plus: Comparisons or small benchmarks you ran yourself, with a conclusion; running models on modest hardware (quantisation, memory, speed); reimplementing a paper or technique; helpful, precise answers in GitHub issues or Discord; small things with real users (a Hugging Face Space, a bot, a plugin).

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world.  - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

What if the busy work just got out of the way?

Behind every great employee experience is a quiet system: the onboarding that feels effortless, the leave handled with care, the paycheck that's right the first time. It's craft most people never see, and we think it deserves the same care we put into the product. We want People Ops that feels like a great mechanical watch: you never think about it, and it's never wrong.

Imagine the first day at a company where every laptop, login, and handshake worked on the first try. That's the bar.

We're looking for a Head of People Operations to lead that work. You'll shape the strategy across People Operations and Total Rewards operations, making everyday work simpler, more reliable, and increasingly agent-enabled.

This is a player-coach role. You'll develop the team, set direction, and stay hands-on, especially as you learn Notion. You'll combine operational craft with thoughtful automation, keeping care and human judgment at the center of every sensitive decision.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Be customer zero for AI-enabled operations. Prototype and scale agents on real workflows, with trusted data, the right access, and human review built in. (Yes, we run our own People Ops on Notion. Yes, it's a little meta.)

 - Build the experience behind the experience. Every hire, change, leave, and farewell runs through the systems you design.

 - Lead a team that wears many hats. You'll coach, set the roadmap, and still get your hands dirty. No boredom guaranteed.

 - Join at a moment of growth. Notion is scaling, and there's a real green field to build something simple and lasting.

 - Work across the whole company. Partner with People, Finance, Payroll, Legal, IT, and BizTech to make handoffs smooth and change stick.

 - Put agents to work, thoughtfully. Test and scale useful workflows with validation and human review. (Automate the busy work, never the judgment.)

 - Lead the team and set the roadmap. Clear ownership, clear priorities, and room for people to grow.

 - Build reliable lifecycle workflows. Onboarding, employee changes, leaves, and offboarding, with clear intake, service standards, and escalation paths.

 - Run Total Rewards operations. Own routine compensation and benefits operations, from cycle readiness and data changes to Payroll handoffs, with accuracy and good judgment on exceptions.

 - Measure what matters. Use service, quality, and adoption data to keep improving, with data integrity and audit readiness built in.

 - Make change stick. Align partners across the company and drive adoption.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You've led a People Operations team in a shared services model and built scalable processes in a growing company, while staying hands-on.

 - You've built People programs and operational processes from the ground up.

 - You know compensation administration and benefits well, with sound judgment on approvals and exceptions.

 - You design great systems and processes across HRIS, case management, and lifecycle workflows. (Workday and global experience are a plus.)

 - You've used AI and automation to improve real work, with privacy, quality, and oversight in mind.

 - You communicate clearly, hold strong beliefs loosely, and lead people through change with kindness and directness.

jobs.description:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â 

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

  • High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients
  • Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better
  • Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential
  • High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
  • Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â  politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â 

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â 

This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â 

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations ManagementÂ 

  • Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
  • Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â 
  • Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â 
  • Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â 
  • Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â 
  • Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ 

  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
  • Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â 
  • Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â 
  • Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â 
  • Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â 
  • Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â 
  • Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â 

Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ 

  • Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â 
  • Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â 
  • Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â 
  • Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â 
  • Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â 
  • Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â 
  • Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â 
  • Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â 
  • Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances.
  • Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â 

Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ 

  • Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â 
  • Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â 
  • Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â 
  • Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â 

Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ 

  • Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â 
  • Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â 
  • Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â 
  • Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â 
  • Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â 
  • Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â 

Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ 

  • Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â 
  • Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â 
  • Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â 
  • Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â 
  • Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â 
  • Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows.
  • Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows.
  • Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â 
  • Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â 

Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ 

  • Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â 
  • Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â 
  • Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â 
  • Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â 
  • Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â 
  • Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â 
Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required QualificationsÂ 

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â 
  • Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â 
  • Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â 
  • Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools.
  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required.
  • Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â 
  • Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â 
  • High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment.

Â Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 
  • 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â 
  • Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred.
  • Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â 
  • Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â 
  • Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â 
  • Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â 
  • Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â 
  • Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â 
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â 
What We Offer

This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid

â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar

â Three weeks of paid vacation annually

â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices

â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise

â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities

â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina.

â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job

How to Apply

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English.

Your application won't be considered without a cover letter. Your cover letter should explain why you're uniquely qualified for this particular position, and why you would be a great fit for our law firm. Generic, copy/paste cover letters will be discarded.

Upload your cover letter and resume, in PDF format, through the software program where you're viewing this announcement.

Please do not call or email us about this opening.
